summary.core_problem: 评测数学链式推理自动形式化系统是否忠实保留原始自然语言推理的正确性与错误性，而不依赖昂贵人工标注或不稳定的 LLM judge。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark/evaluation protocol。它针对 autoformalisation 的 faithful translation 问题提出更便宜、可自动化、并能覆盖正负样本的评测方法；对 verifier、judge、reasoning 评测设计有方法学参考，但与基座预训练距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是自动构造被扰动的、应当无效的推理步骤，并同时衡量两件事：未扰动正确步骤在形式化后是否仍有效，以及扰动错误步骤在形式化后是否仍无效。这样避免完全依赖人工 gold formalisation 或 LLM/embedding 打分。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个数学数据集上评测 8 个 autoformalisation 系统，比较其 validity preservation 与 invalidity preservation。摘要未给出具体最佳系统和数值，但指出现有系统在 faithful translation 上存在可观差异。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括南洋理工大学、牛津大学、爱丁堡大学。作者中 Yee Whye Teh 具备较高学术知名度。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks how to evaluate whether mathematical chain-of-thought autoformalisation systems faithfully preserve both correctness and incorrectness from natural-language reasoning, without expensive human labels or unreliable LLM judges.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol contribution. It offers a cheaper and more automatable way to assess faithfulness in autoformalisation, covering both positive and negative cases. The relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the methodology is useful for verifier/judge design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key idea is to automatically generate perturbed reasoning steps that should be invalid, then measure two properties jointly: validity preservation on original steps and invalidity preservation on perturbed ones. This avoids full reliance on human gold formalisations or model-based judges.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is applied to 8 autoformalisation systems across 4 mathematical datasets, comparing validity and invalidity preservation. The abstract does not expose the exact top system or score table, but it indicates substantial variation in faithfulness across systems.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Nanyang Technological University, the University of Oxford, and the University of Edinburgh. Yee Whye Teh is a notable author.

recommendation.zh: 更像 verifier 评测方法，不是预训练论文；若你在做 formal reasoning 或 judge 设计，读其负样本构造思路，其他部分可略过。
recommendation.en: This is more a verifier-eval paper than a pretraining one; if you work on formal reasoning or judges, read the negative-example construction and skip the rest.

paper.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is emerging as a promising alternative to reinforcement learning for LLM post-training, yet its effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. We study OPD and its advanced variant, On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD$^2$), for mathematical reasoning in English, Korean, and Japanese. OPD$^2$ improves OPD by using the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model as the learning signal. Experiments with Qwen3 show that OPD$^2$ consiste

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是：on-policy distillation 这类替代 RL 的后训练方法，在多语言数学推理里是否仍然有效，尤其是对韩语、日语这类非英语语言，token 级蒸馏信号到底是在提升目标语言推理，还是只是把英语推理能力迁移并外溢到别的语言表面上。论文进一步聚焦 OPD2 的 delta signal 设计，即不用 teacher-student 的概率差，而用 post-trained teacher 相对其 base model 的概率增量作为监督，试图把“后训练新增的推理能力”从 teacher 原本已有的通用语言分布里剥离出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的 pretrain objective，而在于它把 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口问题讲得更具体：如果 teacher 的能力增量可以通过 delta signal 被更干净地提取，那么后训练得到的推理能力就更像一种可迁移的“残差信号”，而不是把 teacher 的全部分布偏好一并蒸馏过去。这个视角对 reasoning-oriented continual pretraining、mid-training、以及用强 teacher 反哺 base model 都有启发。另一个重要点是，论文提醒多语言增益不能只看 benchmark 分数；英语-only 蒸馏能抬高韩语/日语成绩，但可能伴随 reasoning trace 英文化，这说明语言能力迁移和目标语言建模质量不是一回事。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上延续 OPD / OPD2 框架。OPD 的基本做法是：学生模型先按当前策略生成 rollout，再把这条 student trajectory 喂给 teacher，在每个已采样 token 上取 teacher 的条件概率，对学生做 token-level KL 或等价的 token reward 优化。这样做和 sequence-level RL 不同，监督更细，且仍保持 on-policy。OPD2 的改动很小但针对性很强：奖励不再是 log p_teacher(y_t|x,y_<t) - log p_student(y_t|x,y_<t)，而是 log p_teacher - log p_teacher_base。也就是把 teacher 相对其 base 的增量当作监督信号。这样做的动机是减少 teacher 中那些 base 已经具备的通用语言偏好、风格偏好、格式偏好对蒸馏的干扰，把学习重点放在 post-training 新获得的 reasoning preference 上。论文还沿用了 OPD2 原始工作里的两个稳定化部件：一是 reward centering，把 reward 转成 advantage 以缓解收敛点问题；二是用原始 OPD 信号做 conditioning criterion，避免 delta signal 单独使用时训练目标过于脆弱。实验设置上，作者构造了英/韩/日三语数学训练集，总规模 100K，考察多种语言配比与 EN-only 训练情形，核心比较对象是 OPD 与 OPD2 在 Qwen3 系列 instruction-tuned 模型上的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 从正文可确认的关键信息有三点。第一，训练数据是一个 100K 规模的多语言数学数据集，覆盖 English、Korean、Japanese，用来做 on-policy post-training。第二，结论上 OPD2 在多语言设置里稳定优于原始 OPD，且在韩语、日语上的提升更明显，说明 delta signal 在非英语推理迁移里更有用。第三，OPD2 往往能缩小 English 与 Korean 的性能差距，但这种 gap closing 不是所有模型和设置都一致成立，作者对此保持了克制。另一个实验观察很重要：只用英语数据做 OPD，也能提高韩语和日语 benchmark 分数，但生成分析显示，模型常把中间推理过程部分切换到英语，说明分数提升里混入了跨语言推理 trace 泄漏，而不完全是目标语言 reasoning 真正增强。由于给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格和具体数值，无法可靠复述每个模型、每个 benchmark 的精确提升幅度；但论文的主要实验价值不在绝对分数，而在于把 multilingual OPD 的收益与语言漂移副作用同时揭示出来。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，重点抓三个研究问题：OPD2 是否仍优于 OPD、是否缩小语言差距、EN-only OPD 是否真的提升目标语言推理。然后看 On-Policy Distillation 一节，弄清 OPD 与 OPD2 的 reward 定义差别，这是一切实验现象的解释起点。实验部分建议优先看主表和作者对生成样例的分析，尤其是非英语输入下 reasoning trace 是否混入英语。这个现象比单纯分数更值得看。预计 15 到 25 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果只关心方法，不必深究附录里的全部 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether on-policy distillation remains effective for multilingual mathematical reasoning, especially in Korean and Japanese, and whether the gains reflect genuine target-language reasoning improvement or merely transfer of English-centric reasoning behavior. It further studies OPD2, where the supervision signal is the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model, rather than the gap between teacher and student.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is indirect but real. The work sharpens the pretrain–post-train interface: if the useful part of post-training can be isolated as a delta over the base model, then reasoning capability may be distilled as a cleaner residual signal instead of copying the teacher’s full distribution. That matters for continual pretraining, mid-training, and teacher-assisted capability transfer. The multilingual findings are also important: benchmark gains alone can be misleading, because English-only distillation may improve Korean/Japanese scores while shifting the reasoning trace toward English.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method follows the OPD / OPD2 line. In OPD, the student first samples a rollout from its current policy. That sampled trajectory is then scored token by token by the teacher, and the student is updated to reduce the discrepancy on the sampled tokens. Compared with sequence-level RL, this gives denser token-level supervision while preserving the on-policy nature. OPD2 changes the reward definition: instead of using log p_teacher minus log p_student, it uses log p_teacher minus log p_teacher_base. The motivation is to isolate capabilities acquired during post-training, especially reasoning, while suppressing generic language preferences and stylistic biases already present in the teacher’s base model. The paper also keeps the two stabilizers introduced in prior OPD2 work: reward centering to form an advantage-like signal, and a conditioning criterion based on the original OPD signal to avoid pathological convergence. Empirically, the study builds a 100K multilingual math training set in English, Korean, and Japanese, and compares multilingual OPD and OPD2 as well as English-only OPD on Qwen3 instruction-tuned models.
summary_en.experiments: Three findings are clear from the full text provided. First, the training corpus contains 100K multilingual math problems spanning English, Korean, and Japanese. Second, OPD2 consistently outperforms vanilla OPD in multilingual settings, with stronger gains in Korean and Japanese than in English. Third, OPD2 often narrows the English–Korean gap, though the effect is not universal across all models and settings. A particularly useful observation is that English-only OPD can still raise Korean and Japanese benchmark scores, but qualitative inspection shows that the model often drifts into English during the reasoning process. That means some of the measured gain comes from cross-lingual reasoning-trace leakage rather than improved target-language reasoning per se. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so precise benchmark-by-benchmark numbers cannot be stated reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and focus on the three research questions: whether OPD2 still beats OPD, whether it reduces language gaps, and what English-only OPD is actually doing. Then read the OPD formulation carefully; the difference between the OPD reward and the OPD2 delta reward explains most of the empirical behavior. In the experiments, prioritize the main result tables and any qualitative examples showing language drift in the chain of thought. That analysis is more informative than the headline scores. A quick but useful read should take about 15–25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 OPD² 的 delta 目标和跨语言消融；若结论稳，后训练信号应从“模仿强模型”转向“模仿增量”。
recommendation.en: Read the OPD² delta objective and multilingual ablations; if robust, post-training targets should imitate the teacher’s gain, not the teacher distribution.

paper.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that r

summary.core_problem: GRPO等RLVR方法将每个正确completion作为独立学习信号，导致重复出现的正确解法形式按采样频率累积正优势，罕见正确解法形式信用不足。
summary.importance: 识别了RLVR中multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration问题，提出了无需辅助模型推理的轻量修正；对理解GRPO训练动态有机制层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO使用确定性Strategy Cues对验证正确的轨迹构建rollout-local分区，按聚类稀有度重新分配正优势；不需要额外辅助模型推理。Judge Partitions下的Credit Redistribution进一步验证了重新分配机制的有效性。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上评测AIME重复采样性能，Cue-GRPO带来提升，高采样预算下增益最大；JP分区实验表明重新分配机制有效。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR methods like GRPO treat each correct completion as an independent learning signal, causing recurring correct solution forms to accumulate positive advantage proportional to sampling frequency while rare correct forms receive insufficient credit.
summary_en.importance: Identifies multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration in RLVR and proposes a lightweight fix without auxiliary-model inference; useful for understanding GRPO training dynamics at a mechanistic level.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO uses deterministic Strategy Cues to construct rollout-local partitions of verified-correct traces and redistributes positive advantages according to cluster rarity, requiring no auxiliary model inference. Credit Redistribution under Judge Partitions further validates the redistribution mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on AIME repeated-sampling; Cue-GRPO improves performance with largest gains at high sampling budgets. JP partition experiments confirm the redistribution mechanism.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用集中问题的观察比解法更有价值，高采样预算下偏差加剧这一点对大规模RLVR有参考；只看问题形式化和§3即可。
recommendation.en: The credit-concentration observation is more valuable than the fix; the fact that bias worsens at high sampling budgets matters for large-scale RLVR. Read the formalization and §3 only.

paper.title: Soft Guidance Starts to Outperform CoT Prompting as LLMs Improve
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains the standard baseline for evaluating models' reasoning abilities. Originally, this technique was introduced to elicit step-by-step reasoning from large language models (LLMs), which would otherwise tend to directly output the final answer. However, many modern LLMs produce CoT-style responses \textit{natively} when presented with reasoning tasks, which made us revisit the effectiveness of standard CoT prompting.   We evaluate several modern mid-sized lang

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文重新检查一个评测假设：对已经经过推理训练的现代 LLM，few-shot CoT 示例是否仍然是合理的推理能力基线。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练研究的启发主要在评测接口上。早期 CoT prompt 的作用是把模型从“直接给答案”的输出模式拉到“分步推理”的模式；但推理专门模型在预训练后期、SFT 或 RL 阶段已经见过大量推理轨迹，CoT 风格不再稀缺。此时，人工 few-shot 示例可能不再提供有效计算路径，反而引入风格匹配、格式约束和示例分布偏差。这个结论会影响 reasoning model 的能力报告方式，也会影响新推理方法的增益估计：如果 baseline 被 few-shot CoT 压低，后续方法的提升会被高估。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，但问题选得准。作者比较了几类提示方式：标准 few-shot CoT，包括人工编写、随机选择的分步示例；zero-shot free-form generation，即不给额外 CoT 指令，让模型按自身习惯回答；zero-shot CoT，即加入类似“Let’s think step by step”的软提示；以及更强的、由模型生成示例的 CoT 变体，用来减少人工示例风格不匹配的问题。核心观察是，few-shot CoT 对新模型不只是“多给信息”，也会改变生成分布。模型需要同时完成数学推理、模仿示例格式、适配示例中的表达风格，这些附加约束会占用上下文和解码自由度。对已经内化推理格式的模型，收益变小，干扰变大。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在现代中等规模语言模型的数学解题任务上，包含 Mathstral-7B、Qwen 系列和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 等模型。关键数字是：Mathstral 的官方 few-shot CoT 报告约为 77.1%，作者复现的人工 few-shot CoT 最好不超过 74.2%；改用 zero-shot free-form 后达到 83.8%，加入 zero-shot CoT 软提示后进一步到 86.1%。Qwen 上也观察到类似现象，few-shot CoT 最好不超过 83.4%，zero-shot 设置达到 88.6%。论文还给出定性样例，说明模型在复杂文字题中可能已经自然产生分步推理，而额外示例并不一定帮助纠错。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 few-shot CoT 失效机制的分析，以及实验表中 zero-shot、zero-shot CoT、few-shot CoT 的直接对比。值得关注的不是 prompt 技巧本身，而是评测协议随模型训练分布变化而失效的现象。做 reasoning eval、SFT/RL 数据构造或报告模型能力时，应检查 few-shot 示例是否在压制模型的原生输出策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether few-shot Chain-of-Thought prompting is still a valid reasoning baseline for modern LLMs that have already been trained to produce reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation design for reasoning models. CoT prompting originally helped models switch from direct-answer behavior to step-by-step reasoning. For reasoning-specialized models, that behavior is often already learned during late pretraining, instruction tuning, or RL. In this regime, human-written few-shot CoT examples can become an extra constraint rather than useful guidance. They may force style imitation, formatting compliance, and example-specific conventions. This matters because a weak baseline can underestimate model capability and inflate the apparent gains of new reasoning methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares standard few-shot CoT with simpler zero-shot settings. The evaluated variants include human-crafted few-shot CoT examples, free-form zero-shot generation, zero-shot CoT with a light instruction such as “Let’s think step by step,” and stronger CoT variants using model-generated examples. The key technical point is distributional: few-shot CoT does not only add information. It also changes the target generation style. A model must solve the problem while adapting to the demonstrations’ format and reasoning style. For models that already produce reasoning traces natively, this added constraint can hurt more than it helps.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on math problem solving with modern mid-sized models, including Mathstral-7B, Qwen models, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The central numbers are clear. For Mathstral, the best reproduced human few-shot CoT result is at most 74.2%, while the official report gives about 77.1%. Free-form zero-shot generation reaches 83.8%, and zero-shot CoT reaches 86.1%. For Qwen, the best few-shot CoT result is at most 83.4%, while the zero-shot setting reaches 88.6%. The qualitative examples support the same point: some models already generate multi-step solutions without demonstrations, and extra examples can introduce avoidable distractions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s diagnosis of why few-shot CoT can fail, then inspect the tables comparing free-form zero-shot, zero-shot CoT, and few-shot CoT. The useful lesson is not a new prompting trick. It is that evaluation protocols can become stale as the model’s training distribution changes. This is relevant when reporting reasoning capability, constructing SFT/RL data, or comparing new inference-time reasoning methods.

recommendation.zh: 会改变 reasoning eval 的默认 prompt prior；先看实验表和 guidance-distraction 解释，内部评测应立刻复测。
recommendation.en: This should change the default prompt prior for reasoning evals; read the result tables and guidance-distraction argument, then rerun internal eval prompts.

paper.title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning a

summary.core_problem: 基于可验证奖励的在策略强化学习（RLVR）是当前后训练的核心范式，但连续多阶段 RLVR 存在一个被忽视的前向风险：当前阶段的验证器会重塑策略的可采样行为分布，使后续目标的成功轨迹虽仍在理论可达范围内，但在有限采样预算下出现概率过低，无法被后续阶段发现和强化，进而限制后续学习能力。
summary.importance: 重新定义了后训练连续学习的评估维度：从传统的“旧任务性能保留”（灾难性遗忘）转向“未来任务可学习性保留”（有效可奖励支撑集）。这一视角直接影响预训练-后训练接口的设计，包括多目标训练顺序、参考策略约束强度、路由先验的使用方式，以及 RLVR 阶段的采样预算配置。
summary.technical_approach: 提出“有效可奖励支撑集”概念：在指定 rollout 预算下仍能被采样到的奖励为正的轨迹集合。采用双向对照实验设计：从同一基座模型出发，一支做数学推理 RLVR（Math-RLVR）后评估指令遵循支撑集，另一支做约束指令遵循 RLVR（IF-RLVR）后评估数学推理支撑集；再分别用反向验证器继续训练，检验第一阶段的支撑集偏移是否约束后续学习。通过分布分析和受控干预（固定/替换回复开头 token）定位跨任务影响的因果路径。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-8B-Base 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 两个模型家族上验证：Math-RLVR 使 IFEval pass@1 提升 6.5 个百分点，但 best@32 下降，更多 IF 提示趋向“全部成功”或“全部失败”的两极分布；IF-RLVR 则降低数学任务的 best@k，并显著限制后续 Math-RLVR 的提升空间。受控干预显示，跨任务偏移主要发生在回复的前几个 token：RLVR 主要是对基座已有的开头选项做重排，而非删除推理能力；开头选择因果性地决定了数学正确轨迹的可搜索性。顺序训练、参考策略约束、路由先验、在策略蒸馏（OPD）等现有缓解方案只能部分保留支撑集，或在保留支撑集与目标任务收益之间存在取舍。MathIF 和 ReasonIF 上的结果进一步显示，单任务提升无法等比例转化为同时满足两个目标的响应。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第 1 节的支撑集重塑定义与和灾难性遗忘的概念区分；第 3 节的双向实验设计与 best@k 指标选择是方法核心；第 4 节的回复开头因果干预实验是机制洞察的关键，重点关注开头 token 分布变化与数学可搜索性的对应关系；第 5 节的缓解方案评估可用于指导实际训练 recipe。图表重点看 Figure 1（支撑集示意）、展示 pass@1 与 best@k 背离的结果表，以及开头 token 的分布可视化。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the dominant post-training paradigm, but multi-stage sequential RLVR carries an understudied forward risk: the current verifier reshapes the policy's samplable behavior distribution, such that successful trajectories for later objectives remain theoretically reachable but become too rare to appear under a finite rollout budget. These trajectories can then no longer be discovered and reinforced in subsequent stages, limiting future learnability.
summary_en.importance: The work redefines the evaluation dimension of continual post-training learning, shifting from the traditional retrospective view of old-task performance retention (catastrophic forgetting) to a forward-looking view of future-task learnability retention (effective rewardable support). This perspective directly informs the design of the pretrain-posttrain interface, including multi-objective training order, reference-policy constraint strength, routing prior design, and rollout budget allocation across RLVR stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce the concept of effective rewardable support: the set of reward-positive trajectories that remain likely enough to be sampled under a specified rollout budget. A bidirectional controlled design is used: starting from the same base policy, one branch is trained with Math-RLVR and evaluated for instruction-following support, while the other is trained with IF-RLVR (constrained instruction following) and evaluated for math-reasoning support. Each branch is then continued with the opposite verifier to test whether the first-stage support shift constrains later learning. Distributional analysis and controlled interventions (fixing or replacing the opening tokens of responses) isolate the causal pathway of cross-task interference.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across two model families, Qwen3-8B-Base and Qwen2.5-Math-7B. Math-RLVR raises IFEval pass@1 by 6.5 percentage points but reduces best@32, with more IF prompts polarizing toward either consistent success or complete failure. IF-RLVR lowers math best@k and significantly constrains the gains of subsequent Math-RLVR. Controlled interventions show the cross-task shift is localized to the first few response tokens: RLVR primarily reranks opening options already present in the base policy rather than erasing reasoning capability broadly, and the opening choice causally determines the searchability of correct math trajectories. Existing mitigation strategies — sequential training, reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation (OPD) — only partially preserve support or trade preservation against target-task gains. Results on MathIF and ReasonIF further show that single-task improvements do not translate proportionally into responses satisfying both objectives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 1 closely for the definition of support reshaping and its conceptual distinction from catastrophic forgetting. Section 3 covers the bidirectional experimental design and the rationale for using best@k as a support metric, which is the methodological core. Section 4's causal intervention experiments on response openings are the key mechanistic insight — pay attention to the mapping between opening-token distribution shifts and math searchability. Section 5's mitigation evaluation is directly useful for designing practical training recipes. Key figures include the support-shift schematic (Figure 1), tables showing the divergence between pass@1 and best@k, and visualizations of opening-token distributions.

recommendation.zh: 这是 RLVR 训练动态里少见的干净反例：pass@1 上升但 best@32 下降，做 RL 后训练或 pretrain-posttrain 接口时应立刻监控 rewardable support。
recommendation.en: A clean RLVR training-dynamics warning: pass@1 can rise while best@32 falls; monitor rewardable support whenever optimizing verifier-based objectives.

paper.title: Question Begets Question: Self-Evolving Curriculum for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning on Competition Mathematics
paper.abstract: Teaching a language model a skill it has not mastered is obstructed by three recurring difficulties: training data is scarce, ground-truth reasoning traces are usually unavailable, and models often exhibit an apparent ceiling beyond which additional data yields no further improvement. We study these difficulties in a controlled setting, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on competition mathematics (AIME), a task on which it initially solves only 5.6\% of problems (pass@1). To address data scarcity, we

summary.core_problem: 在困难技能学习中，训练数据稀缺、标准答案推理轨迹不可得，而且模型常在增加数据后出现性能平台期。论文以 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AIME 竞赛数学上为受控场景，研究如何用合成数据和强化微调突破这一瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对后训练和数据课程设计有直接参考价值。核心发现不是“多合成数据”本身，而是合成数据的多样性、与当前模型能力的匹配度，以及课程中种子题目的选择。尤其值得注意的是，从“模型基本能做对”的近成功样本生成变体，比从最难失败样本学习更有效，这与常见的“从错误中学习”直觉不同。
summary.technical_approach: Question-begets-Question（QbQ）让教师模型把已有题目改写成探测相同底层技能的多样化变体，避免静态增强中的多样性坍缩。训练只使用题目和最终答案，通过 GRPO 做强化学习，不使用教师的逐步推理轨迹，因此模拟无 oracle reasoning 的场景，并减少蒸馏依赖。自演化课程运行 20 轮：先用 pass@16 评估当前 checkpoint 在上一轮合成题上的表现，将题目分为已掌握、基本能做对、偶尔做对、从未做对四档；然后以“基本能做对”的题目为种子生成变体；再用 GRPO 训练。每轮种子来自上一轮产物，而不是固定原始题集，从而持续适配模型当前能力。
summary.experiments: Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AIME 2025/2026 上的基线 pass@1 为 5.6%。在 1005 道带解答真题上，SFT 达到 9.5%，GRPO 达到 11.5%。用 GPT-5-mini 静态生成 5000 道合成题并与真题合并，仅达到 12.05%。仅用 6000 道 QbQ 合成题、不用真题即可达到 14.5%，但训练最后 30% 出现平台期。在相同数据和计算预算下，自演化课程将 pass@1 提升到 16.5%，20 轮后没有饱和迹象。消融显示从近成功题目播种持续优于从最难题目播种，并且模型能解决未训练过的更难题目。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 30–45 分钟。重点看引言中对三个障碍的拆解、Figure 2 的平台期曲线，以及 QbQ 与自演化课程的流程。最值得深挖的是四档能力划分和“基本能做对”种子选择策略，以及对应的消融实验。数学任务只是载体，关键结论可迁移到其他 RL 数据课程和合成数据设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Learning a difficult skill is constrained by scarce training data, unavailable ground-truth reasoning traces, and apparent plateaus where more data no longer helps. The paper studies this in a controlled setting by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on AIME competition mathematics, a task the base model initially solves at only 5.6% pass@1.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to post-training, synthetic data design, and RL curricula. Its main finding is not that synthetic data helps in the abstract, but that diversity and alignment with the model’s current capability matter. The counterintuitive result is that seeding new problems from near-successes—problems the model can mostly get right—works better than seeding from the hardest failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Question-begets-Question (QbQ) has a teacher model transform existing problems into diverse variants that probe the same underlying skills, reducing the diversity collapse seen in static augmentation. Training uses GRPO with only problem statements and final answers, without teacher step-by-step reasoning traces, which models the no-oracle-reasoning setting and limits distillation. The self-evolving curriculum runs for 20 rounds: evaluate the current checkpoint on the previous round’s problems with pass@16, sort them into mastered, mostly correct, sometimes correct, and never correct bands; seed new variants from the mostly-correct problems; then train with GRPO. Because each round’s seeds come from the previous round’s generated problems rather than a fixed source set, the curriculum continuously tracks the model’s evolving ability.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen2.5-Math-7B starts at 5.6% pass@1 on AIME 2025/2026. On 1,005 real problems with solutions, SFT reaches 9.5% and GRPO reaches 11.5%. Adding 5,000 static synthetic problems from GPT-5-mini to the real data only reaches 12.05%. Training on 6,000 QbQ problems alone, without real problems, reaches 14.5%, but plateaus over the final 30% of training. Under the same data and compute budget, the self-evolving curriculum reaches 16.5% with no sign of saturation after 20 rounds. Ablations show that seeding from near-successes consistently outperforms seeding from the hardest problems, and the resulting model solves harder problems it was never trained on.
summary_en.reading_guide: Spend about 30–45 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s decomposition of the three obstacles, the plateau curve in Figure 2, and the QbQ plus self-evolving curriculum pipeline. The most important technical detail is the four-band evaluation and the choice to seed from mostly-correct problems, together with the corresponding ablations. Mathematics is the testbed; the curriculum lesson transfers more broadly to RL data selection and synthetic-data generation.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 curriculum ablation；它更像 RLVR 数据分布实验，不是数学模型能力报告。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and curriculum ablations; this is a useful RLVR data-distribution study, not just a math fine-tuning result.

paper.title: Is More Privileged Information Better? From Solution Traces to Problem-Solving Structure in Self-Distilled Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by using a privileged view of a model conditioned on reference solutions to supervise a student view that observes only the question. However, the teacher-provided token-level targets may depend on reference-specific information unavailable at inference time. We propose Problem-Space-Guided OPSD (PS-OPSD), which replaces the complete solution with trajectory-grounded guidance describing the initial state, goal conditions, constraints, and a s

summary.core_problem: On-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）中，特权教师侧以完整参考答案为条件生成 token 级监督信号，但完整答案绑定了特定的最终答案、推理顺序、措辞和实例化计算细节，导致教师输出可能依赖学生在推理时（仅看到问题）无法恢复的信息，产生训练-部署的信息不对称，降低知识迁移的有效性。
summary.importance: 将 OPSD 中"教师该看什么"这一特权信息设计问题明确表述为迁移问题，并从经典问题空间理论出发，用结构化的问题求解结构替代完整答案轨迹作为教师上下文，为自蒸馏中的特权信息表示提供了新的设计维度。对推理模型的后训练（尤其是依赖自蒸馏提升推理能力的路线）有方法层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Problem-Space-Guided OPSD（PS-OPSD）。先用一个离线提取器将每条验证过的参考答案转换为 Problem-Space Guidance，记录初始状态、目标条件、约束，以及一条选定的状态转换路径；每个转换包含操作符、前置条件、诱导变换和结果状态。在 OPSD 训练循环中，仅修改特权教师的上下文输入（从完整答案替换为结构化引导），学生侧仍生成仅看问题的 on-policy 轨迹，token 级蒸馏损失保持不变。推理时学生仅从问题出发，不访问参考答案、引导信息、特权教师或提取器。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3 三个规模（1.7B、4B、8B）上评估，覆盖三个竞赛级数学推理 benchmark。在所有三个规模上，PS-OPSD 均取得了对比方法中最高的 aggregate question-only 准确率。通过受控表示变体实验，进一步分析了引导相关性、显式字段结构和状态转换一致性各自的作用；还通过教师输入暴露度分析和下游行为诊断，考察特权信息的表示方式如何影响自蒸馏效果。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节 Problem-Space Guidance 的具体序列化格式和 PS-OPSD 与标准 OPSD 的接口差异——学生侧和损失函数完全不变，只改教师上下文，这一设计很关键。第 4 节的表示变体消融实验（去掉某些字段、用非结构化文本替代等）是理解为什么结构化引导有效的核心。预计阅读时间 30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), the privileged teacher is conditioned on the complete reference solution to produce token-level supervision. However, a complete solution ties reusable mathematical relations to a specific final answer, reasoning order, wording, and instance-specific arithmetic details. As a result, the teacher's token-level targets may depend on information the student cannot recover from question-only input at inference time, creating a training-deployment information asymmetry that reduces transfer effectiveness.
summary_en.importance: The paper explicitly frames the design of privileged information ("what should the teacher see?") in OPSD as a transfer problem. Drawing on classical problem-space theory, it replaces the full solution trace with structured problem-solving structure as the teacher context, introducing a new design dimension for privileged information in self-distillation. It is methodologically relevant for post-training of reasoning models, especially lines that rely on self-distillation to improve reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: PS-OPSD (Problem-Space-Guided OPSD) first uses an offline extractor to transform each verified reference solution into Problem-Space Guidance, which records the Initial State, Goal Conditions, Constraints, and a Selected State-Transition Path. Each transition specifies an Operator, its Preconditions, the induced Transformation, and the Resulting State. Within the OPSD training loop, only the privileged teacher's context is modified—from the complete solution to the structured guidance—while the student continues to generate question-only on-policy trajectories and the token-level distillation objective remains unchanged. At inference, the student reasons from the question alone, with no access to the reference solution, guidance, privileged teacher, or extractor.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3 at three scales (1.7B, 4B, 8B) across three competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Across all three scales, PS-OPSD achieves the highest aggregate question-only accuracy among compared methods. Controlled representation variant experiments further dissect the roles of guidance relevance, explicit field structure, and state-transition coherence. Teacher-input exposure analysis and downstream behavioral diagnostics are also used to examine how the representation of privileged information affects self-distillation outcomes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the concrete serialization format of Problem-Space Guidance and the interface difference between PS-OPSD and standard OPSD—the fact that the student side and loss function are completely unchanged, with only the teacher context modified, is a key design choice. Section 4's representation variant ablations (removing fields, replacing with unstructured text, etc.) are central to understanding why structured guidance works. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 自蒸馏中完整解反而不如结构化问题空间引导有效，做推理增强后训练的可重点看§3方法设计和§4控制实验。
recommendation.en: Full solution traces underperform structured problem-space guidance in self-distillation; check §3 method design and §4 controlled experiments for reasoning post-training.

paper.title: Precise but Uncoupled: Reviewer Precision Does Not Guarantee Critique Uptake in Multi-Agent Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: Many math- and science-oriented agent systems use hierarchical designs with specialized reviewer roles, assuming that a dedicated review stage should help turn wrong candidates into correct ones. We test this assumption on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems using matched gpt-oss-120b actors. Collaboration adds little on the easiest tiers, but from tier 4 onward the gains open sharply; in this harder regime, broadcast-style peer discussion reaches higher final accuracy than a planner-exec

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个推理系统设计问题：在多 agent 数学推理里，专门设置 reviewer 角色是否真的能把错误解修正为正确解。作者给出的答案是否定的，至少在他们测试的层级式 planner-executor-reviewer（PER）协议里，reviewer 即便能高精度指出问题，solver 也常常不采纳这些批评，导致“批评质量”和“修复效果”脱钩。论文把这个现象命名为 reviewer–solver decoupling，并进一步把问题拆成三步：reviewer 是否发现了有用错误、solver 是否据此改变下一版答案、这种改变是否真的完成修复。这个拆解比只看最终 pass rate 更细，也更能解释为什么一些多 agent 设计看起来结构复杂，但收益并不稳定。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 inference-time reasoning protocol 的过程分析，因此只适合 skim。但它仍有两点启发。第一，它提醒人们不要把“更细的角色分工”误当成“更强的推理能力”。如果反馈接口设计不好，增加 reviewer 只是在系统里加入一个高精度但低作用力的模块。第二，它提供了一套较有用的中间诊断指标：NeglectRate、CouplingRate、ReviewerGuidedRepairRate。这类指标对 post-train 和 test-time scaling 都有参考价值，因为它们把系统失败从“模型不会”细分为“模型知道但没改”“改了但没修好”。对做 RL、self-correction、verifier-guided decoding 的人来说，这种过程分解是有信息量的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者不是提出新模型，而是在固定底层模型家族的前提下，系统比较不同多 agent 协议。主比较对象包括：单 agent iterative baseline、broadcast-style peer discussion，以及层级式 PER 协议。关键点在于他们没有只看最终正确率，而是引入 verifier-grounded 的过程评估，把 reviewer 的“检测精度”和 solver 的“采纳执行”分开测量。

具体来说，作者在 Omni-MATH 的 4,181 道题上运行 matched gpt-oss-120b actors，并用 evaluator 判断 reviewer 给出的 critique 是否“有用”。在此基础上定义几类指标：NeglectRate 衡量有用批评被忽略的比例；CouplingRate 衡量收到有用批评后下一版答案是否发生变化；ReviewerGuidedRepairRate 衡量这种变化是否真正把错误答案修成正确答案。这个设计的价值在于，它把多 agent 协议的优劣从一个黑盒结果，拆成了信息发现、信息传递、信息执行三个环节。

作者还做了若干 within-PER 干预，例如 ACK-required、EMB、deeper-reflection variant。ACK-required 属于合规式控制，要求 solver 显式确认 reviewer 意见；EMB 则把 reviewer 指导直接嵌入 solver 的工作上下文，减少信息在角色切换时的丢失。结果显示，这些改动只能部分弥合 PER 与 broadcast 的差距，说明问题不只是 reviewer 说得不清楚，而是层级接口本身存在较强摩擦。
summary.experiments:
实验最关键的发现有四个。第一，在 Omni-MATH 的简单层级（tier 1–2），多 agent 相比 matched single-agent baseline 只带来最多约 2 个百分点提升，说明简单题上协作空间很小。第二，从 tier 4 开始，协作收益明显拉开，在 tier 6–9 可达到约 10–20 个百分点，这说明 benchmark 难度足够高时，多 agent 设计确实有可分辨差异。第三，在这个真正有 headroom 的区间里，broadcast 的最终准确率高于 PER。第四，也是全文最重要的数字：PER reviewer 的 precision 高于 broadcast（0.861 vs. 0.644），但 reviewer-to-action uptake 明显更差；当 reviewer 给出后来被 evaluator 认定为有用的 critique 时，PER 只有 33.6% 的情况下会改变 carried-forward candidate，而 broadcast 为 93.5%；ReviewerGuidedRepairRate 则分别为 0.051 和 0.286。

这些数字说明，PER 的问题不在于 reviewer 看不出错，而在于有用反馈没有有效进入 solver 的下一步推理。作者还提到 reduced cross-family replication with Gemma 3 actors 时，整体协议排序会变化，但 precision–uptake 分离现象仍存在。这意味着“critique uptake”更像一个通用评估维度，而不是只对某个模型家族成立的偶然现象。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐段精读。建议先看 Introduction 前几页，把 role-specialization hypothesis 和 reviewer–solver decoupling 这两个概念吃透。然后直接看主结果图表，重点是不同 difficulty tier 上 single-agent、broadcast、PER 的曲线，以及 reviewer precision、CouplingRate、ReviewerGuidedRepairRate 的对比表。最后再看 within-PER interventions，理解为什么 ACK-required 这类看似合理的控制并没有解决问题。

如果只想抓住结论，20 分钟左右足够。若要多花一点时间，值得看 appendix 里的 cross-evaluator disagreement replay、higher-cost PER-inner6 stress test，以及 Gemma 3 replication。它们不能单独证明因果，但能帮助判断这个现象是否稳健。阅读时要注意，这篇工作研究的是 test-time protocol，不是训练新模型，因此不要把它的结论直接外推到所有多 agent 或所有 verifier 系统。
summary.authors_note: 全文片段未给出明确机构与完整作者列表，无法可靠确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question in multi-agent reasoning: does adding a specialized reviewer role actually improve error correction on hard math problems? The answer, in the tested setting, is often no. A reviewer may identify useful flaws with high precision, yet the downstream solver may fail to act on that critique. The paper names this failure reviewer-solver decoupling and studies it explicitly instead of treating the protocol as a black box. The key issue is not whether critique exists, but whether useful critique is taken up and converted into a repaired solution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, so its relevance is indirect and it belongs in skim territory. Still, it offers a useful lesson for post-training and inference-time reasoning research. Better role specialization does not automatically translate into better reasoning if the interface between roles is weak. More importantly, the paper introduces process-level diagnostics that separate detection quality from actionability. That is valuable for work on verifier-guided decoding, self-correction, RL-based reasoning, and test-time scaling, because it distinguishes between three different failures: the system did not notice the error, noticed it but ignored it, or changed the answer without actually repairing it.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is a protocol study rather than a new model proposal. It keeps the actor family fixed and compares several inference-time designs on the same benchmark: a matched single-agent iterative baseline, a broadcast-style peer discussion protocol, and a hierarchical planner-executor-reviewer protocol, abbreviated as PER. The main methodological contribution is the evaluation decomposition. Instead of reporting only final accuracy, the authors use verifier-grounded analysis to measure whether the reviewer produced useful critique, whether the next candidate answer changed in response, and whether that change repaired the solution.

This leads to three central diagnostics: NeglectRate, which measures how often useful critique is ignored; CouplingRate, which measures whether the next answer actually changes after useful critique; and ReviewerGuidedRepairRate, which measures whether that change leads to a correct repair. This decomposition is the paper’s strongest idea. It turns a protocol comparison into a process analysis.

The authors also test several within-PER interventions. ACK-required is a compliance-style control that forces explicit acknowledgment of reviewer feedback. EMB injects reviewer guidance directly into the solver’s working context to reduce interface friction. A deeper-reflection variant is also explored. These interventions recover only part of the gap between PER and broadcast, suggesting that the issue is not simply reviewer quality but the structure of feedback routing itself.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems using matched gpt-oss-120b actors. The tiered benchmark is important because easy math benchmarks are too close to ceiling to separate protocols cleanly. The main findings are clear. First, on tiers 1 and 2, collaboration adds little, at most around 2 percentage points over the matched single-agent baseline. Second, from tier 4 onward, collaboration starts to matter, and gains reach roughly 10 to 20 points on tiers 6 to 9. Third, in that regime, broadcast outperforms PER in final accuracy.

The most informative numbers are the process metrics. PER’s reviewer has higher precision than broadcast’s reviewer, 0.861 versus 0.644. But when the reviewer gives critique that the evaluator later confirms as useful, PER changes its carried-forward candidate only 33.6 percent of the time, while broadcast does so 93.5 percent of the time. ReviewerGuidedRepairRate is 0.051 for PER versus 0.286 for broadcast. These numbers strongly support the paper’s central claim: reviewer precision alone does not explain protocol quality if critique uptake is weak.

The appendix-level evidence also matters. A reduced replication with Gemma 3 actors changes the overall ranking of protocols, but the precision-versus-uptake separation remains. That suggests critique uptake is a meaningful evaluation axis beyond one specific model family.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This paper is best read selectively. Start with the introduction and make sure the two central concepts are clear: the role-specialization hypothesis and reviewer-solver decoupling. Then go straight to the main tier-by-tier accuracy plots and the tables for reviewer precision, CouplingRate, and ReviewerGuidedRepairRate. Those figures carry most of the paper’s substance. After that, read the within-PER intervention section to see why simple controls such as forced acknowledgment do not solve the problem.

A 20-minute read is enough to capture the main result. If you want more confidence in robustness, inspect the appendix sections on cross-evaluator disagreement replay, the higher-cost PER-inner6 stress test, and the Gemma 3 replication. The important reading caution is that this is a test-time protocol study, not a training paper, so its conclusions should not be overgeneralized to all multi-agent or verifier-based systems.

recommendation.zh: 反常识的多Agent协作机制结论，做推理时Agent编排或RL reviewer设计的重点看摘要中的精度与采纳率对比数据。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive multi-agent collaboration findings; researchers working on inference-time agent orchestration or RL reviewer design should focus on precision vs uptake comparison data in the abstract.

paper.title: AIMO Interpretability Challenge
paper.abstract: We propose the AIMO Interpretability Challenge, a competition on distinguishing robust from spurious reasoning in frontier mathematical language models based on the models' internal mechanisms. The challenge is motivated by a central limitation of standard reasoning benchmarks: strong final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a model relies on stable reasoning mechanisms or exploits brittle reasoning shortcuts. summary.core_problem: 这项挑战赛要解决的问题是：在数学推理模型答案正确率相近时，如何用内部机制和受控变体测试区分“稳定推理”与“脆弱捷径”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是训练方法，而是评测信号。它把数学推理能力的评测从最终答案推进到机制层面：模型是否在符号变体、对抗扰动、结构化分布偏移下仍使用一致的推理路径。这个信号对预训练和后训练都有参考意义。预训练侧可以用它诊断语料记忆、题型模板依赖和推理泛化；后训练侧可以用它评估 CoT、RL、verifier 训练是否只是提高可见答案率，还是改善了内部可泛化机制。贡献量级取决于最终开放的模型访问、表示接口和标注质量。当前内容更像挑战赛设计稿，不是已有实验结论。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，构建奥赛级数学题集合，来源包括 AIMO 2、AIMO 3、JMO 和近两年 AIME，总计 180 道题，并保证训练集和测试集中各有 50% 是未在互联网公开的新题。这是为了降低训练污染和检索式记忆。第二，为原题构造符号推理链标注。它借鉴 GSM-Symbolic 的函数化变体思想，但目标从小学算术提升到奥赛级推理。符号链不是简单答案解析，而是描述有效解法中的逻辑依赖，使组织方能够生成大量受控变体，并改变表面条件、变量、结构或干扰项。第三，参赛者需要结合行为表现和模型内部表征，判断模型面对这些变体时是否具有稳健机制。和 RAVEL、InterpBench、MIB 这类偏合成或半合成的可解释性 benchmark 不同，该挑战不要求恢复预先植入的已知 circuit，而是要求在前沿模型和真实高难推理任务上判断机制是否能跨实例泛化。
summary.experiments: 没有传统意义上的实验结果。可确认的量化信息包括：核心题库 180 道奥赛级问题；训练和测试中各 50% 为新发布题；计划基于符号推理链生成大规模对抗变体；挑战赛预计吸引约 20–40 个质量较高的 interpretability/generalization 方向提交。文中还提到 AIMO 3 在 Kaggle 上吸引超过 4000 个队伍，用来说明社区对奥赛级推理系统已有较高参与度。需要注意的是，论文没有报告参赛基线、内部表征接口、评分函数细节、模型列表或稳健性标签的一致性检验。这些会决定该挑战赛最终能否成为可靠评测资产。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 competition description 中的科学目标、三类数据组件、与 RAVEL/InterpBench/MIB 的区别。最值得追问的是评分协议：参赛者能访问哪些内部激活或注意力信息，稳健模型和脆弱模型的标签如何产生，符号变体如何避免引入新的歧义，以及机制解释如何和最终鲁棒性绑定。对预训练研究员来说，不需要细读竞赛组织背景，重点关注它是否能产出可用于训练污染诊断和推理泛化诊断的题目生成工具。

summary_en.core_problem: The challenge asks whether internal model evidence can distinguish robust mathematical reasoning from brittle shortcut use when models obtain similar final-answer accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining is evaluative rather than algorithmic. Final-answer math scores are a weak signal for model development because they conflate reasoning, memorization, formatting, and exploitation of surface cues. A benchmark built around symbolic variants and internal mechanisms could provide a sharper diagnostic for contamination, template dependence, and reasoning generalization. It may also help separate post-training methods that merely improve answer accuracy from those that create more stable reasoning behavior. The impact depends heavily on the final scoring protocol, model access, and annotation quality; the current document is a competition proposal, not an empirical study.
summary_en.technical_approach: The design combines olympiad-level problems, symbolic reasoning annotations, and access to frontier reasoning models. The problem pool includes 180 tasks from AIMO 2, AIMO 3, JMO, and recent AIME sets, with half of both train and test problems claimed to be newly published to reduce internet leakage. The organizers annotate symbolic reasoning chains that capture logical dependencies in valid solutions. These chains are then used to generate controlled adversarial variants, in the spirit of GSM-Symbolic but at a much harder mathematical level. Participants are expected to infer robustness from behavior and internal representations. This differs from benchmarks such as RAVEL, InterpBench, and MIB, which often test interpretability methods in synthetic or semi-synthetic settings with known factors or planted circuits. Here the target is whether interpretability tools can make useful judgments about real frontier models on difficult reasoning tasks.
summary_en.experiments: There are no completed experimental results. The concrete numbers are the planned 180-problem corpus, 50% newly published problems in both train and test splits, symbolic annotations for variant generation, and an expected 20–40 strong submissions. The proposal also cites more than 4,000 teams participating in AIMO 3 on Kaggle as evidence of community interest. Missing details include baseline interpretability methods, the exact internal-access interface, robustness-label construction, inter-annotator validation for symbolic chains, and the final metric. These details will determine whether the challenge becomes a reusable scientific instrument or mainly a competition event.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the scientific goal, the three data components, and the comparison with RAVEL, InterpBench, and MIB. The key questions are how robustness labels are produced, what internal activations or traces are exposed, how symbolic variants preserve mathematical equivalence, and how explanations are scored against generalization behavior. Pretraining researchers can skip most organizational material and focus on whether the dataset could support contamination analysis, reasoning-data filtering, or post-training diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和鲁棒变体生成；它把数学评测从答对拉到机制层，适合改内部 eval。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and robustness-variant generation; it pushes math evaluation from answer accuracy toward mechanisms, useful for internal eval design.

paper.title: FormalAnalyticGeo: A Neural-Symbolic Based Framework for Multimodal Analytic Geometry Problem Generation
paper.abstract: Math reasoning has achieved significant progress with the rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), however analytic geometry remains largely underexplored, primarily due to the scarcity of annotated samples. Existing diagram generation approaches struggle with analytic geometry: template methods cannot handle constraint-driven layouts, and generative models lack the geometric precision to render annotated conic curves correctly. We present FormalAnalyticGeo, a scalable fram

summary.core_problem: 多模态解析几何题数据稀缺，现有图表生成方法无法同时满足约束驱动布局和几何精度要求。
summary.importance: 提出了一个可扩展的多模态数学题生成框架，属于数据合成类工具工作。
summary.technical_approach: FormalAnalyticGeo框架围绕形式化中间表示CDL构建，通过有符号距离场(SDF)引擎实现精确图表渲染，串联四个专用LLM组件（生成器、形式化器等）完成全自动题目生成。
summary.experiments: 验证了框架在解析几何题目生成上的多样性和几何精度，未做大规模模型训练评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal analytic geometry problem data is scarce; existing diagram generation methods fail at both constraint-driven layout and geometric precision.
summary_en.importance: A scalable multimodal math problem generation framework, categorized as a data synthesis tooling work.
summary_en.technical_approach: FormalAnalyticGeo is built around CDL, a formal intermediate representation bridging problem text and precise diagram rendering via a Signed Distance Field engine, with four sequential specialized LLM components.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on diversity and geometric precision of generated analytic geometry problems; no large-scale model training evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 形式化+SDF生成多模态数学题的思路有参考性，但属于小领域数据合成工具，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The formal-language-plus-SDF approach for multimodal math problem generation is interesting, but it is a niche data synthesis tool; read the abstract only.

paper.title: MIRA-Math: A Benchmark for Minimal Information Requesting and Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Mathematical reasoning benchmarks typically provide all facts needed to solve each problem, while interactive benchmarks often mix reasoning with tools, retrieval, and long-horizon dialogue. We introduce MIRA-Math, a benchmark for a narrower diagnostic capability: solving mathematical problems whose full latent state has a unique answer, but whose solver-facing view is missing exactly one necessary atomic fact. The solver must request the missing information in natural language under a strict bu

summary.core_problem: 评测模型在数学题中发现并请求唯一缺失原子事实的能力，而不是在已给全信息的条件下直接推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测资产。它把“缺信息时该问什么”从工具使用、检索、多轮对话和长程规划中剥离出来，形成一个更窄、更可控的诊断任务。
summary.technical_approach: MIRA-Math 构造数学问题的完整潜在状态，并在 solver 可见视图中删除恰好一个必要原子事实。模型必须在严格预算内用自然语言请求缺失信息，再用返回事实给出精确答案。响应器是固定受限 LLM，只能在请求匹配数据集中标注的原子事实时返回该事实，否则拒绝；实例生成、hint specification、验证和最终答案检查尽量确定化。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 2310 个生成实例，覆盖 22 类数学模板或 typed mathematical settings。摘要未给出完整模型列表、参数规模和各模型结果，只说明请求质量通过固定 LLM-mediated responder channel 评估，最终答案用确定性验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark tests whether a model can identify and request exactly one missing atomic fact needed to solve a math problem.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution. It isolates minimal information requesting from broader interactive settings that mix reasoning with retrieval, tools, and long-horizon dialogue.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIRA-Math defines problems with a complete latent state and hides exactly one necessary atomic fact from the solver. The solver must ask for the missing information under a strict budget and then produce an exact final answer. A fixed constrained LLM responder only returns the dataset-provided fact when the request matches it; otherwise it declines. Generation, typed hints, validation, and final-answer checking are designed to be deterministic.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 2,310 generated instances from 22 typed mathematical categories. The abstract does not report model sizes or full benchmark tables, but states that request metrics are measured through a fixed LLM-mediated response channel and final answers are deterministically verified.

recommendation.zh: 可作信息请求能力的小型诊断集；预训练研究员看任务定义即可，别把它当数学推理能力主指标。
recommendation.en: Useful as a narrow diagnostic for information seeking; read the task definition, but do not treat it as a main math-reasoning signal.

paper.title: PluraMath: Extending Mathematical Reasoning Evaluation Beyond High-Resource Languages
paper.abstract: Mathematical reasoning has become a central task for evaluating and tuning reasoning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing benchmarks remain heavily biased toward high-resource languages, with English and Chinese dominating both pre-training corpora and evaluation suites. The recently released PolyMath (Wang et al., 2025) dataset represents a significant step forward, yet its coverage is still limited to 18 only high-resource languages. To address this gap, we introduce PluraMath, an extens

summary.core_problem: 现有数学推理评测过度集中在英语、中文和少数高资源语言，难以衡量 LLM 在低资源语言中的数学推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测数据集扩展。PluraMath 将 PolyMath 扩展到 18 种代表性不足的语言，覆盖 6 个语系，补齐多语数学推理评测中低资源语言缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于 PolyMath 构建多语版本，采用预计算翻译加母语者人工校验的流程，重点控制翻译质量、语义一致性和数学表达准确性，而不是直接使用机器翻译结果。
summary.experiments: 论文用 PluraMath 评测 27 个 reasoning LLM，覆盖 small、mid-size、large 和 closed-source ensemble 四类规模。摘要未给出具体模型清单、分语言分数或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Technical University of Munich、MCML、MDSI、Charles University、Applied AI Institute 等机构，团队背景偏多语 NLP 与评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing math reasoning benchmarks are concentrated in English, Chinese, and a small set of high-resource languages, leaving low-resource multilingual reasoning poorly measured.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation dataset contribution. PluraMath extends PolyMath with 18 underrepresented languages across 6 language families, targeting the low-resource gap in multilingual math reasoning evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built by extending PolyMath through precomputed translations followed by native-speaker validation, with emphasis on translation fidelity, semantic consistency, and preservation of mathematical meaning.
summary_en.experiments: The paper benchmarks 27 reasoning LLMs across small, mid-size, large, and closed-source ensemble settings. The abstract does not provide the detailed model list, per-language scores, or quantitative deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Technical University of Munich, MCML, MDSI, Charles University, and Applied AI Institute, with a background mainly in multilingual NLP and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 作为多语 reasoning eval 的备查即可；预训练研究员主要看语言覆盖和翻译校验流程，不必读模型排名。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multilingual reasoning eval reference; for pretraining work, inspect the language coverage and validation pipeline, not the leaderboard.

institutions: Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur)

paper.title: Failure Modes of Large Language Models on Research-Level Mathematics: A Taxonomy and an Empirical Characterisation
paper.abstract: The "First Proof" benchmark [1] posed ten research-level mathematics questions to the strongest publicly available LLMs and found them consistently wrong-not silent, but confidently, fluently wrong. This paper asks why. Working from the per-question post-mortems in First Proof's Appendix A, I identify four failure modes: citation fabrication (F1), premise smuggling (F2), silent problem reformulation (F3), and local-to-global compatibility gaps (F4). I then audit eight one-shot proofs generated b

summary.core_problem: 分析公开强模型在研究级数学问题上为何会生成自信但错误的证明，并区分不同失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是错误模式 taxonomy 与小规模经验分析。它对 reasoning reliability 和数学评测有参考价值，尤其指出问题不只是假引用；但样本量很小，不能直接转化为预训练或 RL recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 First Proof benchmark 附录的逐题 post-mortem，提出四类失败：citation fabrication、premise smuggling、silent problem reformulation、local-to-global compatibility gaps。随后用两个专门检测 F1/F2 的工具审计 Gemini 2.5 Flash 在第 1、2、5 题上的八个 one-shot proof。
summary.experiments: 审计对象是 Gemini 2.5 Flash 生成的 8 个 one-shot proofs。中心发现是 8 个证明中没有确认的伪造引用，但每个证明至少包含一个未证明却承担关键作用的“基本结果”或“标准论证”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes why strong public LLMs produce confident but wrong proofs on research-level mathematics and separates the failures into distinct modes.
summary_en.importance: This is a failure-taxonomy and small empirical analysis contribution. It is relevant to reasoning reliability and math evaluation, especially because it argues that the issue is not merely fabricated citations. The sample is small and does not directly imply a pretraining or RL recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using per-question post-mortems from the First Proof benchmark appendix, the paper defines four failure modes: citation fabrication, premise smuggling, silent problem reformulation, and local-to-global compatibility gaps. It then audits eight one-shot Gemini 2.5 Flash proofs for Questions 1, 2, and 5 using instruments designed to surface F1 and F2.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical audit covers eight one-shot proofs generated by Gemini 2.5 Flash. None contains a confirmed fabricated citation, but every proof contains at least one load-bearing claim asserted as a fundamental result or standard argument without justification.

recommendation.zh: 只看 taxonomy 和八例审计结论；样本太小，但“premise smuggling”比假引用更棘手这个信号值得记下。
recommendation.en: Read only the taxonomy and eight-case audit; the sample is tiny, but the premise-smuggling signal is more interesting than citation hallucination.

paper.title: Blockwise Policy-Drift Gating for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student policy using teacher signals computed on trajectories sampled by the student itself. Recent work shows that sampled-token OPD can be fragile on long-horizon reasoning tasks and that local teacher-support matching is a simple and effective repair. This paper introduces blockwise policy-drift gating, a lightweight student-only old-current drift controller for OPD under rollout reuse. The method computes log-probability shifts between the behavior stude

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 on-policy distillation 在长链推理训练中的一个稳定性问题：当 student rollout 被重复用于多个优化 epoch 时，当前 student 与生成这些 rollout 的旧 student 之间会发生 policy drift，导致同一条 sampled path 对当前更新来说“新鲜度”不同。已有工作更多关注 teacher 监督是否足够可靠，比如 sampled-token OPD 的脆弱性以及 Teacher-TopK/LSM 对局部 teacher support 的修复；这篇文章补的是另一块：即使 teacher target 不变，reused rollout 本身也会因为 old-current mismatch 变得不均匀可信，尤其在长响应里这种失配会沿序列累积。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口有现实意义。原因在于，很多后训练配方已经越来越像“继续训练一个会推理的语言模型”，而不是简单 SFT。OPD、RL、蒸馏这类方法的稳定性，会反过来影响大家如何理解 teacher-student compatibility、rollout reuse、以及长链 reasoning 数据的有效训练信号密度。论文的价值不在提出一个新目标，而在给出一个很轻量的 loss reweighting 规则：不改 teacher、不改 rollout policy、不改 support matching，只根据 student 自身 old/current log-prob shift 来调节哪些位置更该被当前更新重视。这个思路比较务实，也容易嵌入现有 PPO-style 训练框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 blockwise policy-drift gating。作者先定义 sampled token 路径上的 old-current log-probability shift，也就是当前 student 对某个已采样 token 的对数概率，与生成该 token 的 behavior student 的对数概率之差。这个量不是完整 KL，只是沿 sampled path 的局部漂移信号。直接用 token-level importance ratio exp(d_t) 做权重会很噪，因此作者选择中间粒度聚合：一类是固定 64 token 的 Block64-Gate，另一类是按换行切分并做长度修正的 NewlineSpan-Gate。对每个 block/span，把 shift 求平均，经过 detached soft gate 和 mean normalization 后，广播回该区域内所有 token，作为已有 OPD position loss 的乘子。关键点有三个。第一，gate 是 detached 的，不让模型为了操纵 gate 而学习；它只改变损失权重，不引入额外优化目标。第二，teacher target 完全不变，因此该方法既可加在 sampled-token OPD 上，也可叠加到 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上。第三，分块而不是逐 token，是为了在长 reasoning trace 中平衡方差和局部性：sequence-level 太粗，token-level 太抖，block-level 是折中。
summary.experiments: 实验设置比较克制。student 是 Qwen3-1.7B-Base，teacher 是 Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO；训练数据来自 DAPO-Math-17k 处理后的 1,791,700 行数学样本；统一采用 200 step 训练预算、最大 response 长度 16384、rollout group size 8、两轮 PPO epoch。评测用外部 vLLM，主指标是四个数学 benchmark 上的 pass@8。论文主结论是：固定 64-token block 的 drift gate 能稳定提升 sampled-token OPD 的 solve rate；而在 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上继续叠加该 gate，也能得到最强的 aggregate pass@8。摘要没有给出完整数字表，但从全文描述看，作者更强调趋势一致性而不是单点大幅跃升：token-level importance weighting 噪声较大，sequence-level weighting 过于粗糙，blockwise aggregation 在六个方法变体里表现最稳。这个结果与方法设计是对齐的，因为它本来就是为 rollout reuse 下的 stale-data 问题服务，而不是试图替代 teacher support matching。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言里对 OPD 两类失配的区分：一类是 teacher support 不足，另一类是 old-current student drift。把这两件事分开理解，后面的方法就很清楚。然后看 policy-drift gating 章节，重点抓住 gate 的定义、detached 设计、mean normalization，以及为什么选 block64 和 newline span 这两种粒度。最后看主实验矩阵，关注六个变体在四个数学 benchmark 上的相对排序，而不是只盯单个分数。若只想判断是否值得跟进，读方法部分加主结果表大约 20 到 30 分钟即可。更值得深挖的问题是：这种 drift-aware weighting 是否能推广到更长训练预算、更强 teacher、以及 RL-only setting；另外，它和 PPO 里的 importance sampling / clipping 之间是否存在更系统的统一视角。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a stability issue in on-policy distillation for long-horizon reasoning. When student rollouts are reused across multiple optimization epochs, the current student can drift away from the behavior student that generated those trajectories. This creates a mismatch even if teacher supervision is unchanged: some sampled positions become stale for the current update. Prior work has mostly focused on teacher-side reliability, such as the fragility of sampled-token OPD and the repair provided by Teacher-TopK or local support matching. This paper targets a different failure mode: old-current student drift under rollout reuse.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Modern post-training increasingly resembles continued language-model training with stronger reasoning behavior, so the stability of OPD, RL, and distillation affects how researchers think about teacher-student compatibility, rollout reuse, and the density of useful training signal in long reasoning traces. The paper’s value is its restraint: it does not introduce a new teacher objective or a new rollout policy. Instead, it adds a lightweight loss reweighting rule based only on the student’s own old-versus-current log-probability shift. That makes it easy to plug into existing PPO-style pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is called blockwise policy-drift gating. For each sampled response token, the paper computes the old-current log-probability shift: the difference between the current student’s log-probability and the behavior student’s log-probability on the same sampled token. This is not a full KL estimate; it is a sampled-path drift signal. Using token-level importance ratios such as exp(d_t) is a natural baseline, but the paper argues that it is too noisy. Instead, it aggregates drift at an intermediate granularity. Two variants are used: Block64-Gate, which averages shifts over fixed 64-token blocks, and NewlineSpan-Gate, which aggregates over newline-delimited spans with heuristics for merging or splitting spans by length. The aggregated score is passed through a detached soft gate and mean-normalized over valid response tokens, then broadcast back to all positions in the region as a multiplicative weight on the existing OPD position loss. Three design choices matter. First, the gate is detached, so the model cannot optimize the gate itself; it only changes how much each position contributes to the base loss. Second, teacher targets are unchanged, so the same gating family can be applied both to sampled-token OPD and to Teacher-TopK/LSM. Third, blockwise aggregation is a variance-locality trade-off: sequence-level weighting is too coarse for long traces, while token-level weighting is too unstable.
summary_en.experiments: The setup is controlled rather than large-scale. The student is Qwen3-1.7B-Base and the teacher is Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO. Training uses 1,791,700 processed math rows from DAPO-Math-17k, with a fixed 200-step budget, maximum response length 16384, rollout group size 8, and two PPO epochs. Evaluation is done externally with vLLM, and pass@8 on four math benchmarks is the main metric. The main finding is that fixed 64-token drift gating consistently improves sampled-token OPD solve rate, and that adding the same gate on top of Teacher-TopK/LSM yields the strongest aggregate pass@8 among the tested variants. The abstract does not expose the full numeric table, and the paper’s emphasis is more on consistent ranking than on a single dramatic gain. That is aligned with the method’s role: it is meant to mitigate stale-data effects under rollout reuse, not to replace teacher-support matching.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and pay attention to the distinction between two kinds of mismatch: insufficient teacher support versus old-current student drift. Once that separation is clear, the method section becomes straightforward. In the policy-drift gating section, focus on the gate definition, the detached design, the mean normalization, and why the paper chooses Block64 and newline spans as the two aggregation granularities. Then look at the main experiment matrix and compare the relative ordering of the six variants across the four math benchmarks rather than over-reading any single score. If the goal is just to judge whether the idea is worth following up, the method section plus the main result table should take about 20 to 30 minutes. The more interesting follow-up questions are whether this drift-aware weighting scales to longer training budgets, stronger teachers, or RL-only settings, and how it relates more systematically to importance sampling and clipping in PPO.

recommendation.zh: OPD是推理能力轻量化落地的核心路径，重点看§3的块级漂移聚合方式，可作为内部推理蒸馏ablation的 baseline 参考。
recommendation.en: On-policy distillation is a core path for lightweight reasoning deployment; focus on §3's block-wise drift aggregation as a baseline for internal reasoning distillation ablations.

paper.title: Hard or Just Unreached? Diagnosing the Sampling Blind Spot in Math-Reasoning Difficulty Estimation
paper.abstract: Math and science reasoning benchmarks rely on pass@k, the fraction of sampled chains that reach gold, as the canonical per-example difficulty signal. The same signal drives RL with verifiable rewards, math data curation, synthetic curricula, and verifier training. We show this proxy has a persistent blind spot on its hardest stratum: on the eight free-form math cells we test (GSM8K and MATH across four open-weight models), 10.3-22.9% of the examples that no sampling seed solves in six tries are

summary.core_problem: 这项工作诊断 pass@k 作为数学推理难度估计的盲区：一个题目在若干次温度采样中没有被解出，并不一定说明模型不会做，也可能只是采样轨迹没有到达可解区域。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近预训练和 post-train 接口问题。pass@k 不只是评测指标，还被用于 RL with verifiable rewards、数学数据筛选、合成 curriculum、verifier 训练和难度分桶。如果 pass@k=0 的样本中有一部分其实可被同一个模型在非采样轴上解出，那么数据过滤、奖励训练和难度标注都会把“未被采样触达”误当成“真实困难”。这会影响 RLVR 数据保留策略、hard negative 构造、推理数据课程和 verifier 校准。论文的贡献不是提出一个实用解码器，而是给出一个诊断：采样多样性不能代表模型可达解空间的全部。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较两类等计算预算的探索方式。第一类是常规 temperature sampling，用 k=6 条 sampled chains 估计 pass@k，并把没有任何链到达正确答案的题目视为最难层。第二类是 deterministic regime：greedy decoding 加上 5 个通过 activation grafting 产生的确定性变体。activation grafting 的做法是在最后一个 prompt token 的 residual-stream hidden state 上替换为廉价构造的 synthetic vector，然后继续 greedy decoding。这样可以固定 prompt 和权重，只改变确定性前向轨迹。它不是部署用的解码方法，而是用来判断“模型内部是否存在被采样漏掉的可达解”。作者还比较不同 graft 类型的 correct set 重叠，用 fix-set Jaccard 检查这些扰动是否只是同一条轴上的重复探索。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个开源 instruction-tuned 模型：Qwen-2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-Nemo-12B；任务包括 GSM8K、MATH 和 MMLU-Pro。单次解码上，greedy 与平均 single-sample accuracy 持平或更好，最高差距约 2.8 个百分点。对 k=6 的采样，pass@6=0 的题目层在 GSM8K 上占 5.1% 到 8.3%，在 MATH 上占 28.7% 到 43.5%。在这些采样完全失败的样本上，6 条确定性链，也就是 greedy 加 5 种 graft，能在 GSM8K 和 MATH 的 8 个 model-benchmark cell 中恢复 10.3% 到 22.9%；如果包含全部 12 个 cell，恢复范围约为 10% 到 29%。greedy alone 在这些 hardest stratum 上最多只解出约 6% 到 9%，说明收益主要来自确定性扰动的覆盖扩展。不同 graft 类型的 fix-set Jaccard 在所有 cell 中通常不超过 0.47，只有同轴 random probe pair 在一个设置中达到 0.76，支持“不同扰动触达不同可解子集”的解释。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精读，约 25 到 35 分钟。Introduction 的三条 empirical observations 是主线，先看清楚作者并不是声称 deterministic decoding 总体优于 sampling，而是指出二者 correct set 部分不重合。表 3 值得看，用来理解 pass@6=0 stratum 的规模。Fig. 3 和附录 C 展示采样边际收益递减，可判断该现象是否只是 k 太小。Section 5 是技术重点，说明 activation grafting 如何构造确定性链，以及恢复比例如何随 deterministic budget 增长。附录 F 的 Jaccard 分析适合检查不同 graft 是否提供了真正不同的覆盖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines a blind spot in using pass@k as a difficulty signal for math reasoning. If no temperature-sampled chain solves a problem, the problem may not be intrinsically hard for the model; it may simply be unreached by the stochastic decoding paths used to estimate difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to the interface between pretraining, reasoning post-training, and data curation. pass@k is widely used in RL with verifiable rewards, math-data filtering, synthetic curricula, verifier training, and hardness annotation. If a nontrivial part of the pass@k=0 bucket is reachable by the same model through another axis of exploration, then sampling-only pipelines can mislabel reachable examples as unsolvable. That affects which examples are dropped, upweighted, downweighted, or assigned to hard buckets. The contribution is diagnostic rather than a new inference recipe: sampling diversity does not fully characterize the model’s reachable solution space.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares two matched-compute regimes. The first is standard temperature sampling with k=6 chains, where examples solved by no chain form the hardest stratum. The second is a deterministic regime: greedy decoding plus five activation-grafting variants. Activation grafting replaces the hidden state at the last prompt token with cheap synthetic vectors and then continues with greedy decoding. This keeps the prompt and weights fixed while perturbing the deterministic trajectory through the residual stream. The method is used as a diagnostic tool, not as a recommended deployment decoder. The paper also measures overlap between the sets fixed by different graft types using fix-set Jaccard scores, to test whether the perturbations explore distinct regions rather than repeating the same trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use four open-weight instruction-tuned models: Qwen-2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Mistral-Nemo-12B. Benchmarks include GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro. At one sample, greedy decoding is competitive with or better than the mean single-sample accuracy, with gaps up to about 2.8 percentage points. Under k=6 sampling, the pass@6=0 stratum is 5.1% to 8.3% on GSM8K and 28.7% to 43.5% on MATH. On this no-sample-solves slice, the six-chain deterministic regime recovers 10.3% to 22.9% of examples across the eight free-form math cells, and roughly 10% to 29% across all twelve cells. Greedy alone solves only up to about 6% to 9% of this stratum, so the gain comes from diversified deterministic perturbations. Fix-set Jaccard scores are at most 0.47 in every cell for most graft-type pairs, with one same-axis random-probe pair reaching 0.76, supporting the claim that different grafts reach partially distinct correct sets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with attention to the empirical logic; expect about 25 to 35 minutes. The Introduction lays out the key claim: deterministic variants do not necessarily beat sampling in aggregate accuracy, but they reach a subset that sampling misses. Table 3 is useful for the size of the pass@6=0 stratum. Figure 3 and Appendix C show diminishing marginal returns from additional samples, which matters for ruling out a too-small-k explanation. Section 5 is the main technical section for activation grafting and recovery under matched compute. Appendix F is worth checking for the Jaccard analysis of whether graft types provide distinct coverage.

recommendation.zh: 直接冲击数学RL和数据筛选的核心度量，做推理增强预训练或数学合成数据的人应重点看§3的盲区比例和激活嫁接方法细节。
recommendation.en: Directly undermines the core metric for math RL and data curation; researchers working on reasoning-augmented pretraining or math synthetic data should focus on §3 blind-spot ratios and activation grafting details.

paper.title: LLM Parameters for Math Across Languages: Shared or Separate?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial cross-lingual variation in mathematical reasoning performance, but it remains unclear whether these differences reflect language-specific parameters or a shared mechanism that manifests differently by language. We present a cross-lingual mechanistic analysis of mathematical reasoning in LLMs, enabling us to localize and compare model parameters that support mathematical reasoning across languages. We find that the extracted math-associated paramet

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：多语言数学推理能力差异，究竟来自一套共享的数学参数回路在不同语言上的不同激活，还是来自语言各自依赖的独立参数子网。作者不是只看性能差，而是沿着 mechanistic localization 的路线，直接在参数层面提取各语言的“math-associated parameters”，再比较这些参数集合在不同语言之间的重合度、层内分布和功能作用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于给 multilingual pretrain 的参数分工提供了更细的证据。结论比较清楚：数学推理并不是完全语言独立，也不是完全语言专属，而是“中间层部分共享、深层更分化”的结构；同时英语对应的数学相关参数集合更大，低资源语言更小。这对理解 multilingual scaling、语言竞争、参数共享边界、以及后续是否需要 language-specific adaptation 都有启发。量级上，它更像一篇机制分析型工作，而不是会立刻改写训练 recipe 的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上基本建立在 MathNeurosurgery 框架之上。作者先对每个参数计算 task-specific score：一方面看该参数权重大小，另一方面用输入特征范数做归一化，再分别在数学数据和非数学数据上统计。随后在每一层取 top-k 重要参数，并把“对数学任务重要、但对非数学任务不重要”的部分定义为 math-specific parameters。为了做跨语言比较，作者对英语、德语、法语、印地语分别独立提取这类参数集合，再用 Jaccard coefficient 衡量两种语言之间的参数重合度。关键点有三个。第一，它比较的是参数集合而不是隐藏表示，因此更接近“电路是否共用”的问题。第二，它不仅看全模型重合，还看逐层重合，所以能看到中间层共享、前后层分化的结构。第三，作者还做了 weight intervention，用功能性干预验证这些被提取出的参数确实与数学能力相关，而不是统计噪声。和已有多语言数学研究相比，这篇工作的区别在于它不把问题停留在 benchmark performance 或 representation similarity，而是把分析对象下沉到参数子集。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Llama 3.2 1B Instruct、Qwen3 4B IT-2507、Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 三个模型，主文重点分析 Llama 1B，较大模型结果放在附录。数学数据使用 GSM8K，多语言为英语、德语、法语、印地语；非数学对照数据使用 MMLU 和 RACE。主要结果有四点。第一，在不同 top-k 设置下，英语始终拥有最多的 math-associated parameters，德语和法语居中，印地语最少，这个排序与数学推理性能排序一致。第二，跨语言 Jaccard overlap 在中间层最强，在浅层和深层较低，而且大模型上这一趋势更明显。第三，重合度整体显著高于随机基线，说明确实存在共享的数学参数底座，而不是完全分散的语言专属回路。第四，后层重合下降被作者解释为语言特化增强：参数预算更大时，模型更有能力为不同语言分配专门子网络，缓解 multilinguality 带来的竞争。摘要里没有给出很多精确数值，正文可见的重点更多是趋势图和层分布图，而不是单一 headline number。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，不必逐式推导。建议先看 Introduction，明确它要区分“共享机制”和“语言专属机制”这两个假设。然后重点看方法部分里 task-specific score、top-k 提取和 Jaccard overlap 的定义，理解它到底把什么叫作 math-specific parameter。实验部分优先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2：一个看不同语言的参数数量，一个看逐层 overlap 形状，这两张图基本承载了主要结论。附录里大模型结果值得扫一遍，主要看趋势是否稳定。预计 20 到 30 分钟能抓住主线。真正值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种参数定位方法对 top-k、对照任务选择是否敏感；二是“英语参数更多”到底反映训练数据占比、tokenization 差异，还是推理路径更集中，这篇还没有完全拆开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise mechanistic question: when multilingual LLMs show different math reasoning performance across languages, are they relying on a shared math circuit expressed through different languages, or on language-specific parameter subsets? Instead of comparing outputs or hidden states, the authors localize math-relevant parameters for each language and measure how much those parameter sets overlap.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is diagnostic rather than recipe-changing. The main takeaway is that multilingual math reasoning is neither fully shared nor fully language-specific: overlap is strongest in middle layers, while later layers become more language-specialized. The finding that English consistently has a larger set of math-associated parameters than lower-resource languages also speaks to multilingual allocation, capacity competition, and the limits of parameter sharing. This is more useful as evidence about multilingual internal organization than as a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on MathNeurosurgery. For each parameter, the authors compute a task-specific importance score using the parameter magnitude together with an activation normalization term derived from input feature norms. They compute these scores separately on math data and non-math control data. Within each layer, they select the top-k important parameters and define math-specific parameters as those important for math but not for unrelated tasks. They repeat this extraction independently for English, German, French, and Hindi, then compare the resulting parameter sets with Jaccard similarity. Three aspects matter here. First, the comparison is done at the parameter-set level rather than representation similarity, so it is closer to asking whether the same circuit is reused. Second, the analysis is both model-wide and layer-wise, which reveals where sharing happens. Third, they include weight intervention experiments to validate that the localized parameters are functionally tied to math reasoning rather than being a statistical artifact. Relative to prior multilingual math work, the novelty is the parameter-level localization across languages.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, Qwen3 4B IT-2507, and Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, with the main text centered on the 1B Llama model and larger-model results in the appendix. GSM8K is used for math reasoning, across English, German, French, and Hindi; MMLU and RACE serve as non-math controls. The main empirical findings are consistent across settings. English always yields the largest set of math-associated parameters, German and French are in the middle, and Hindi has the smallest set, matching the performance ranking. Pairwise Jaccard overlap peaks in intermediate layers and drops in early and late layers. The overlap stays well above a random baseline for most layers, indicating a genuinely shared substrate for math reasoning. In larger models, the late-layer drop becomes more pronounced, which the authors interpret as stronger language-specific specialization enabled by larger parameter budgets. The paper is more about stable structural trends than a single headline metric, so the key evidence is in the layerwise plots rather than one summary number.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to frame the two competing hypotheses: shared multilingual math circuitry versus language-specific circuitry. Then read the method section just enough to understand the task-specific score, top-k extraction, and Jaccard overlap. In the experiments, Figure 1 and Figure 2 carry most of the argument: one shows how many math-associated parameters each language gets, and the other shows where overlap concentrates across layers. It is also worth checking the appendix briefly to see whether the same pattern holds for larger models. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for the main message. The parts worth deeper scrutiny are the sensitivity to top-k and control-task choice, and whether the English advantage comes from data exposure, tokenizer effects, or a more distributed reasoning circuit.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不会直接改你的 recipe，但会影响你对 multilingual parameter sharing 的先验；重点看中间层重叠和英语占用更大参数子集这两个结论。
recommendation.en: It will not change your recipe directly, but it should update your prior on multilingual parameter sharing; focus on the mid-layer overlap and the larger English math-parameter footprint.

paper.title: MathVis-Fine: Aligning Visual Supervision with Necessity via Progressive Dependency-Guided Training for Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has extended from purely linguistic domains to multimodal scenarios; however, existing approaches often treat visual inputs as homogeneous or auxiliary signals, failing to capture the intricate and sample-specific dependencies between text and images in mathematical problem-solving. This gives rise to two core issues: first, the supervisory signals for visual content are generalized and coarse-grained, lacking adaptation to the actual necessity of visual informat

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态数学推理中视觉监督过粗的问题：不同样本对图像信息的依赖程度不同，但现有训练常把视觉输入统一当作辅助信号。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态推理训练数据与训练策略。它把“图像是否必要、必要到什么程度”显式标注出来，用来减少视觉奖励或监督信号的误配，对 VLM 后训练和多模态 CoT 数据构造有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 MathVis-Fine 数据集，为数学题加入细粒度视觉标注和 visual dependency rating；再基于这些依赖关系做 progressive dependency-guided training，使模型先学习视觉必要性，再把视觉证据纳入推理过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练集规模和具体提升幅度。实验重点应是多模态数学推理任务，对比普通 CoT、多模态监督和不区分视觉依赖的训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses coarse visual supervision in multimodal mathematical reasoning, where existing methods treat images as uniformly useful auxiliary inputs despite sample-specific visual dependency.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a data-and-training recipe for VLM reasoning. By annotating whether and how much visual information is necessary, it targets a common failure mode in multimodal CoT training: applying the same visual reward or supervision to all samples.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build MathVis-Fine with fine-grained visual annotations and visual dependency ratings, then introduce progressive dependency-guided training so the model learns visual necessity before integrating visual evidence into reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, dataset scale, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation setting is multimodal mathematical reasoning against standard CoT, multimodal supervision, and dependency-agnostic training baselines.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 数学后训练数据设计备查即可；核心 insight 是视觉监督要按样本必要性分层，不值得按预训练论文细读。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLM math post-training data reference; the main signal is sample-level visual necessity, not a pretraining-level method.

paper.title: Visored: A Controlled-Natural-Language Prover for LLM-Generated Mathematics
