paper.abstract: We present a dependent-type-based prover designed around the way LLMs (and humans) tend to write mathematics, complementing existing systems such as Lean and Rocq. Its core design choices are a surface that imitates mathematical natural language and a rule-driven automation layer that closes the routine steps a textbook would omit, so that an accepted proof can be re-emitted as a checked Lean file. Early experiments suggest that, even without any prover-specific training data, LLMs can learn to

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM 生成数学证明难以可靠验证的问题。Lean、Rocq 这类证明助手可以给出 kernel-level 检查，但要求输入已经高度形式化；而 LLM 和人类更常写自然语言数学证明。直接从非形式化 LaTeX 翻译到 Lean 很脆弱，因为类型、强制转换、边界条件、库引理选择和部分函数定义域等决定经常没有显式写在原文里。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对数学推理模型的 post-training、自动验证、数据生成和 reward 设计有启发。Visored 的价值在于把“自然语言证明”和“机器可检查证明”之间加了一层受控自然语言与依赖类型 IR。这个中间层可以让 LLM 仍在接近训练语料分布的表达方式中工作，同时把语义选择显式化，并为失败步骤提供局部诊断。对于构造可验证数学推理数据、训练 verifier、给 proof generation 提供 dense feedback，这类系统比只用最终 Lean 编译成败更有可操作性。
summary.technical_approach: Visored 是一个面向 LLM 生成数学的 controlled-natural-language prover。输入是嵌在 LaTeX 中的受控数学英语，句式模板和 LaTeX 命令由外部 spec 文件定义，而不是硬编码在 parser 中。系统把输入 elaboration 成依赖类型 IR，并在这一层显式处理 subtype、cast、库引理、边界约定和部分函数定义域。它继承 PVS 风格的 well-definedness 检查，例如 1/x 需要能推出 x≠0，sqrt(x) 需要 x≥0，log(x) 需要 x>0。每个 “Then ...” 义务由 cost-bounded、rule-driven solver 尝试关闭，目标是补全教科书证明中常被省略的常规步骤，而不是做完全自动定理发现。通过检查的证明可以再输出为 Lean 4 文件做 kernel-level re-verification，但 Visored 自身的判定不依赖 Lean。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的实验定位是早期原型验证，主要围绕 miniF2F，覆盖中学层级的集合论、代数和不等式。作者强调即使没有 prover-specific training data，LLM 也能学习使用 Visored 的受控语言接口。文中更看重系统闭环是否成立：LLM 负责给出接近自然数学文本的证明 outline，Visored 负责类型检查、well-definedness 检查、常规推理闭合和局部错误反馈。实验不是大规模模型训练结果，也不是证明搜索能力与 Lean tactic 系统的直接替代比较；它展示的是一种更适合 LLM 写作习惯的验证接口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 附近的设计 thesis：LaTeX、Visored IR、Lean 之间的投影关系，以及为什么 LaTeX 到 IR 是困难的语义解析问题。然后看 Architecture，重点关注 spec-driven surface、dependent-type IR、well-definedness 检查和 solver 如何处理 “Then” obligations。Appendix B/C/E 若有时间可以翻阅，分别对应受控语言、IR 和 solver。对预训练研究员而言，最值得留意的是第 5 节提到的使用模式：inference-time verifier、autoformalizer loop、dense reward signal 和 data generator。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the verification gap for LLM-generated mathematics. Systems such as Lean and Rocq provide strong kernel-checked guarantees, but they expect already formalized statements and proofs. LLMs and humans usually produce informal or semi-formal mathematical prose, where types, coercions, side conditions, library choices, and edge-case conventions are often implicit. Direct autoformalization into Lean is therefore brittle and can silently change the meaning of the original proof.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not primarily a base-pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to mathematical reasoning post-training, verified data generation, verifier design, and reward construction. Visored introduces a controlled natural language layer backed by a dependently typed intermediate representation. This lets the model write in a format closer to natural mathematical text while forcing hidden semantic commitments to become explicit. The design can provide more localized feedback than a single Lean compilation failure, which matters for training proof generators and building checked reasoning corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: Visored is a controlled-natural-language prover for mathematical proofs written in LaTeX-like prose. Its accepted sentence templates and LaTeX commands are specified through external configuration files rather than being hard-coded into the parser. The input is elaborated into a dependently typed IR where subtype choices, casts, named lemmas, edge-case conventions, and domain restrictions are represented explicitly. The elaborator enforces well-definedness in the style of PVS: expressions such as 1/x, sqrt(x), and log(x) require proof obligations for x≠0, x≥0, and x>0 respectively. Each “Then ...” step is discharged by a cost-bounded rule-driven solver intended to close routine steps that a textbook proof would omit. Accepted proofs can be emitted as Lean 4 for kernel-level rechecking, although Visored’s own acceptance decision is not routed through Lean.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are positioned as an early prototype study around miniF2F, covering middle-school-level set theory, algebra, and inequalities. The key claim is that LLMs can learn to use the Visored interface even without prover-specific training data. The empirical focus is not large-scale model training or a head-to-head replacement of Lean tactic search. It is a feasibility check of the workflow: the LLM supplies a controlled-natural-language proof outline, while Visored performs type checking, well-definedness checking, routine proof closure, and localized diagnostics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 30–40 minute skim. Read the introduction around Figure 1 first; it explains the role of Visored as an intermediate representation between LaTeX-like mathematical prose and Lean. Then read the architecture section for the spec-driven surface language, the dependently typed IR, well-definedness obligations, and the solver for “Then” statements. Appendices B, C, and E are the useful technical references if more detail is needed. For pretraining-oriented work, the most relevant part is the proposed usage modes: inference-time verification, autoformalization loops, dense reward signals, and checked data generation.

recommendation.zh: 将形式化证明的语法向自然语言拉近，降低了 LLM 生成 Lean 代码的难度，对构建数学 RL 环境和合成数据极具启发，建议关注其自动化填补逻辑。
recommendation.en: Brings formal proof syntax closer to natural language, lowering the difficulty for LLMs to generate Lean code; highly inspiring for building math RL environments and synthetic data. Recommend focusing on its automation logic for filling gaps.

paper.title: A Gradient Perspective on RLVR Stability and Winner Advantage Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but GRPO-style optimization remains prone to collapse. We analyse this instability through token-level gradient dynamics, deriving a taxonomy that predicts how updates affect next-token probabilities and entropy. The taxonomy shows that stability depends jointly on the advantage sign and token distribution under the current policy. Motivated by this finding, we propose Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (W

summary.core_problem: 如何解决带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中 GRPO 风格优化容易崩溃的不稳定性问题？
summary.importance: 深入分析了 RLVR 训练不稳定的 token 级梯度动态机制，并提出了一种极其简单但有效的在线策略梯度目标（WAPO），显著提升了数学推理等任务的训练稳定性，对当前火热的 R1-Zero 范式（RL-pretrain）有直接的指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 通过 token 级梯度动态分析，推导出一个分类法，预测更新如何影响 next-token 概率和熵。发现稳定性共同取决于优势（advantage）的符号和当前策略下的 token 分布。基于此，提出 Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO)：一种简单的在线截断策略梯度目标，仅对具有正优势（positive-advantage）的补全（completions）进行更新。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理和多跳 QA 基准测试中，WAPO 提高了跨多个模型系列的训练稳定性，并匹配或超越了基线方法（如 GRPO）。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Layer6 AI，该团队在强化学习和语言模型优化方面有持续产出。

summary_en.core_problem: How to resolve the instability and collapse issues in GRPO-style optimization for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)?
summary_en.importance: Provides a deep analysis of the token-level gradient dynamics causing instability in RLVR, and proposes an extremely simple yet effective online policy gradient objective (WAPO) that significantly improves training stability on tasks like math reasoning. Highly relevant to the current R1-Zero paradigm (RL-pretrain).
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes token-level gradient dynamics to derive a taxonomy predicting how updates affect next-token probabilities and entropy. Discovers that stability depends jointly on the advantage sign and the token distribution under the current policy. Proposes Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO), a simple online clipped policy-gradient objective that updates *only* on positive-advantage completions.
summary_en.experiments: Across mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, WAPO improves training stability and matches or outperforms baselines (like GRPO) across multiple model families.
summary_en.authors_note: From Layer6 AI, a team with consistent output in reinforcement learning and language model optimization.

recommendation.zh: 直击 GRPO 训练容易崩溃的痛点，通过 token 级梯度分析得出“只对正 advantage 更新”的 WAPO 策略，极其简单且 clean，强烈建议在内部 RL 实验中立刻复现对比。
recommendation.en: Directly addresses the collapse issue in GRPO training. The token-level gradient analysis leads to WAPO ('update only on positive advantage'), which is extremely simple and clean. Strongly recommend immediate replication in internal RL experiments.

paper.title: The Quality-Utility Paradox: Why High-Reward Data Impairs Small Model Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation from powerful reasoning models is widely used to improve Small Language Models (SLMs) on mathematical reasoning, often assuming that traces with higher reward model scores provide more useful supervision. We identify a counterintuitive \textbf{Quality-Utility Paradox} in mathematical reasoning distillation. Data refined or synthesized by a stronger Oracle obtains higher perceived quality according to reward models, yet consistently underperforms traces generated by the SLM

summary.core_problem: 解决小模型数学推理蒸馏中的一个反常现象：奖励模型评分更高、看起来更“优质”的推理轨迹，为什么反而让学生模型学得更差。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在新蒸馏框架本身，而在于指出了一个会直接影响合成推理数据和后训练配方的失配机制：高 reward 不等于高 utility。对做 SFT/RL 数据构造、teacher-student distillation、以及 pretrain↔post-train 接口的人都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Quality-Utility Paradox：强 Oracle 对轨迹做 refinement 或 synthesis 后，虽然 reward model 评分更高，但会把样本分布推离学生模型原生 reasoning style，导致 adaptation cost 上升，抵消逻辑修复带来的收益。为验证这一机制，提出 Style-Aligned Refinement，在保留学生模型原生轨迹风格的前提下进行逻辑修复，尽量减少 distributional drift。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5、LLaMA-3、DeepSeek 等多个模型家族的小模型数学推理蒸馏设置；比较对象包括 Oracle refined/synthesized traces 与学生模型自生成后经 rejection sampling 选出的轨迹。摘要结论是：前者 reward 更高但训练后效果更差，而 style-aligned refinement 能恢复部分收益。摘要未给出具体参数量、数据量和提升幅度，但 setup 横跨多个家族，说明现象不是单一模型偶然性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a counterintuitive issue in small-model math reasoning distillation: why traces with higher reward-model scores can be less useful for training the student.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not a new distillation pipeline per se, but a concrete failure mode for synthetic reasoning data and post-training recipes: high reward does not imply high utility. This matters directly for SFT/RL data construction, teacher-student distillation, and the pretrain-to-post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate the Quality-Utility Paradox: Oracle refinement or synthesis improves apparent trace quality under reward models, but also induces distributional drift away from the student's native reasoning style, increasing adaptation cost and offsetting the benefit of better logic. To test this mechanism, they propose Style-Aligned Refinement, which repairs logic while preserving the student's native trajectory style.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans math reasoning distillation setups across Qwen2.5, LLaMA-3, and DeepSeek model families. It compares Oracle-refined/synthesized traces against traces generated by the student itself and selected via rejection sampling. The abstract claims the former score higher under reward models yet train worse, while style-aligned refinement recovers part of the loss. Exact model sizes, data scale, and gains are not given in the abstract, but the multi-family setup suggests the effect is not a one-off artifact.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你对“高分合成 CoT 就该拿来蒸馏”的 prior；先看机制分析和 ablation，若 setup 干净，内部数据筛选准则要立刻加一条 style-distance。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that high-reward synthetic CoT is automatically good distillation data; read the mechanism and ablations first, and add a style-distance filter if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Architecture-Aware Reinforcement Learning Makes Sliding-Window Attention Competitive in Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: The rapid progress of reasoning and agentic large language models (LLMs) has increased the demand for long-context inference, but self-attention (SA) scales quadratically with context length.   To address this, we study SWARR (Sliding-Window Attention with Reinforced Adaptation for Math Reasoning), a practical recipe for adapting SWA models to mathematical reasoning. SWARR has two stages: (1) efficient conversion from a pretrained SA model to SWA with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which avoids p

summary.core_problem: 全局自注意力在长上下文中成本过高，但将预训练好的 SA 模型直接改成滑动窗口注意力（SWA）后，在数学推理这类“短输入、长生成”任务上经 SFT 仍有明显掉点；核心问题是这个差距究竟来自 SWA 架构本身的能力上限，还是来自 SFT 数据与 SWA 局部性约束不匹配。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对架构和 post-train 接口有实际参考价值。结论不是“SWA 天然不行”，而是仅用为 SA 准备的 SFT 数据评估 SWA，会低估其能力；经过 on-policy RL 适配后，生成轨迹变得更局部，较大窗口的 SWA 可以非常接近 SA。对预训练研究的启发有两点：一是架构约束与训练数据分布之间存在耦合，评估线性注意力/局部注意力时不能只看 SFT 后的一次性结果；二是 RL 或 on-policy adaptation 可以改变模型依赖模式，相当于把策略重新拉回到架构可达的局部计算图内。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWARR，两阶段流程。第一阶段不从头预训练，而是把现成的 SA 基模型直接替换成 SWA，再做架构无关的 SFT 得到初始化。第二阶段在 SWA 约束下做 RL 策略适配，让模型用自己生成的轨迹优化，而不是强行模仿 SA 风格的长程依赖链。文中将这一现象概括为 data-architecture mismatch：标准 SFT 数据大多来自 SA 模型，含有 SWA 难以复现的长程引用和回指结构；RL 因为是 on-policy，会自然偏向在窗口约束下可行的局部推理组织方式。除主流程外，还用 SWA 生成数据做对照 SFT，并定义生成轨迹的 locality 指标来验证假设。
summary.experiments: 基模型为 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Base。SFT 后，窗口 8k/4k/2k 的 SWA 相对 SA-SFT 分别低 6.1、9.0、17.8 个点。经过等 step 的 RL 后，SWA-8k 与 SA 差距缩小到 0.4 点；等训练时间比较下，SWA-4k 也具备竞争力；SWA-2k 仍落后，但差距缩小到 2.5 点。分析显示 RL 后的轨迹局部性更强；用 SWA 自己生成的数据做 SFT，相比直接用 SA 生成的 SFT 数据，对 SWA 的伤害更小，支持“数据-架构错配”解释，而不只是 RL 单纯提点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看三块：引言中关于短输入长生成任务为何难、SFT 后不同窗口大小的掉点表、以及后半部分关于 locality 和 architecture-matched SFT 数据的消融。重点不是具体 recipe，而是“SWA after SFT understates viability; RL adapts trajectories to the architecture”这一判断。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。若做线性注意力或局部注意力模型，可进一步细看轨迹局部性指标如何定义。
summary.authors_note: 同济大学、上海 AI 实验室等；通讯作者为刘凯、陈凯。

summary_en.core_problem: Global self-attention is expensive for long contexts, but directly converting a pretrained SA model to sliding-window attention and applying standard SFT leaves a clear gap on math reasoning, a short-input, long-generation task; the key question is whether this gap reflects a hard limitation of SWA or a mismatch between SFT data and SWA’s locality constraint.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to the interface between architecture and post-training. Its main message is practical: evaluating SWA only after architecture-agnostic SFT can underestimate its viability, because standard SFT corpora are prepared for SA models and may encode long-range dependencies that are awkward under SWA. After on-policy RL adaptation, larger SWA windows become nearly competitive with SA. For pretrain-oriented research, this matters in two ways: architecture constraints and training data distribution are coupled, so linear/local attention should not be dismissed from SFT-only checkpoints; and RL or on-policy adaptation can reshape dependency patterns, steering the policy toward trajectories that are representable inside the local compute graph.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWARR is a two-stage recipe. Stage 1 avoids retraining from scratch: take a pretrained SA base model, replace global attention with SWA, and apply architecture-agnostic SFT as a warm start. Stage 2 runs RL adaptation under the SWA constraint, so optimization uses trajectories generated by the current model itself rather than forcing imitation of SA-style long-range chains. The hypothesis is data-architecture mismatch: standard reasoning SFT data come from SA models and contain long-range references that are hard for SWA to reproduce, while on-policy RL naturally favors reasoning organizations that are feasible within the window. The paper also runs a controlled cross-SFT comparison using SA- versus SWA-generated data and defines trajectory locality metrics to test the hypothesis.
summary_en.experiments: The base model is Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Base. After SFT, SWA with 8k/4k/2k windows lags SA-SFT by 6.1, 9.0, and 17.8 points respectively. After equal-step RL, SWA-8k closes the gap to 0.4 points versus SA; under equal training time, SWA-4k becomes competitive; SWA-2k still lags but the gap shrinks to 2.5 points. Analysis shows RL produces more local generation trajectories, and SWA-generated SFT data hurts SWA less than SA-generated SFT data, supporting the mismatch explanation rather than a generic RL gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim three parts: the introduction’s argument for why short-input long-generation is hard for efficient attention, the main gap table after SFT versus RL, and the later ablations on locality and architecture-matched SFT data. The durable takeaway is less the recipe itself than the conclusion that SWA looks much weaker after plain SFT than it does after on-policy adaptation. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes. Readers working on linear/local attention should inspect how trajectory locality is operationalized.
summary_en.authors_note: Tongji University, Shanghai AI Lab, among others; corresponding authors are Kai Liu and Kai Chen.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它把“架构差距”部分改写成“后训练轨迹分布不匹配”；先看假设是否成立，再决定要不要在你们的长上下文 recipe 里加 RL 适配。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it reframes part of the architecture gap as a post-training trajectory mismatch; validate that hypothesis before adding RL adaptation to your long-context recipe.

paper.title: Evaluating Research-Level Math Proofs via Strict Step-Level Verification
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to rigorously verify complex mathematical proofs. Standard global evaluation approaches suffer from "context poisoning," in which superficially plausible statements mask subtle logical flaws, leading to hallucination or over-skepticism. To address this, we shift from global evaluation to strict step-level verification: our framework maintains detailed context for each deduction step and strictly constrains the sources of applied theorems. We evaluate on a ca

summary.core_problem: 解决研究级数学证明评估中，整体式判断容易被表面合理但局部错误的推导污染，导致 verifier 出现 hallucination 或过度怀疑的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测协议与验证方法，而不是训练方法。它把 proof evaluation 从全局打分改成严格的 step-level verification，并基于对抗性研究级证明集分析错误类型，这对 reasoning eval 和 verifier 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上维护每一步推导的细粒度上下文，并严格限制可调用定理来源；通过 step-level deductive constraints 避免全局 prompt 在长证明中被错误上下文污染。论文还做系统性消融，比较严格约束与 unconstrained global prompting 的差异。
summary.experiments: 评测数据来自 FirstProof challenge 中精心整理的 research-level adversarial proof suite。摘要未给出具体模型、样本数和准确率，但明确声称：无约束的全局评估持续无法定位细微逻辑错误，而 step-level verification 不仅效果更好，还改变了失败分布，剩余错误更多是知识缺失而非严重逻辑幻觉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the failure of global proof evaluation for research-level mathematics, where superficially plausible statements can poison context and hide subtle logical errors.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation and verification protocol rather than a training method. By shifting from global judgment to strict step-level verification on adversarial research-level proofs, it offers a useful reference for reasoning evaluation and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework maintains detailed context for each deduction step and strictly constrains the source of applicable theorems. This step-level deductive setup is contrasted against unconstrained global prompting, with ablations showing the necessity of the constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a curated adversarial suite of research-level proofs from the FirstProof challenge. The abstract does not report model sizes, dataset size, or exact metrics, but claims that unconstrained global evaluation consistently fails to localize subtle logical errors, while strict step-level verification both improves performance and changes the failure taxonomy toward knowledge gaps rather than severe logical hallucinations.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但对 verifier 设计有一条硬结论：全局 proof judging 很容易被 context poisoning 搞坏；看 error taxonomy 和 ablation 就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it makes one hard point for verifier design: global proof judging is brittle to context poisoning; the ablation and error taxonomy are the parts to read.

paper.title: SG-OPD: Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation via Sign-Consistency Gating and Phased Teacher Sampling
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense per-token supervision from a stronger teacher, and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its effectiveness implicitly relies on two assumptions that frequently break in practice: trajectory-level alignment between the student and the teacher, and uniform token-level reliability of the teacher's preferences. We therefore propose Sign-Gated On-Policy Disti

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) 依赖两个在实践中经常不成立的隐含假设——学生与教师轨迹对齐、教师 token 级偏好可靠——导致效果下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次系统分析 OPD 的隐含失效假设，并提出基于二分类验证器(verifier)作为教师可信度信号的双层门控机制，在数学推理 benchmark 上超越标准 OPD。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SG-OPD，用二分类验证器在两个互补粒度上做教师可信度门控：(1) phased teacher sampling 在冷启动阶段混入验证器认可的教师轨迹；(2) sign-consistency gate 在教师与验证器方向一致时外推 distillation 更新、不一致时内插。
summary.experiments: 在竞赛级数学推理 benchmark 上进行实验，SG-OPD 一致超越标准 OPD。（摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度）
summary.authors_note: 作者来自国内高校/研究院，作者名单中未发现业内知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) implicitly relies on two frequently violated assumptions—trajectory-level student-teacher alignment and uniform token-level teacher reliability—leading to degraded performance.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first systematic analysis of OPD's implicit failure assumptions, proposes a dual-gating mechanism using a binary verifier as teacher trust signal, outperforms standard OPD on math reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: SG-OPD uses a binary verifier as trust signal at two granularities: (1) phased teacher sampling mixes verifier-endorsed teacher rollouts during cold-start; (2) sign-consistency gate extrapolates distillation updates where teacher agrees with verifier-correct direction and interpolates where it disagrees.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks show SG-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD. (Specific model sizes and improvement margins not given in abstract.)
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Chinese universities/research institutes; no widely recognized researchers identified in the author list.

recommendation.zh: OPD 是后训练的重要范式，这篇文章指出了其隐含失效假设并提出基于 verifier 的门控，核心 insight 值得关注，但实验规模不够大，读 §3 和 §4 即可。
recommendation.en: OPD is an important post-training paradigm; this paper identifies its implicit failure assumptions and proposes verifier-based gating. Core insight is worth noting, but experiment scale is modest—read §3 and §4 only.

paper.title: CrowdMath: A Dataset of Crowdsourced Mathematical Research Discussions
paper.abstract: Large language models have made substantial progress on mathematical reasoning, but existing benchmarks typically evaluate well-specified problems with final answers, step-by-step solutions, or complete proofs. They do not capture collaborative open-problem solving: a setting in which participants propose partial arguments, identify gaps or errors in prior steps, repair flawed reasoning, and gradually synthesize incremental contributions into a proof. We introduce CrowdMath, a dataset of 164 exp

summary.core_problem: 解决现有数学推理评测只看封闭题最终答案，无法衡量模型在开放式、协作式研究讨论中的增量推理能力。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测资产。CrowdMath 把数学能力从“解题”扩展到“研究讨论过程建模”，覆盖提出部分进展、识别错误、修补论证和逐步合成证明，这对 reasoning 数据构造、过程监督和 agent 式数学研究评测都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者整理 MIT PRIMES–AoPS CrowdMath 2016-2025 的协作讨论，构建 164 条专家标注的 progress chains。每条链从开放问题到完整证明，帖子被标注为不同功能角色，如部分进展、证明完成、错误推理、错误识别等，并据此定义评测任务，衡量模型对研究型讨论状态和贡献类型的理解。
summary.experiments: 数据集规模为 164 条 progress chains，来源是真实多人数学研究讨论而非合成轨迹。摘要未给出具体参评模型、baseline 和分数，但可以预期实验会比较模型在角色识别、进展判断、错误检测或链式理解上的表现。规模不大，统计功效有限，但数据形态较新。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 MIT 数学界背景学者 Pavel Etingof，数据来源于 MIT PRIMES–AoPS CrowdMath 项目，带有较强真实数学研究讨论属性。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap in current math reasoning benchmarks, which focus on closed-form problems and final answers but fail to measure incremental reasoning in collaborative open-ended research discussions.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset. CrowdMath extends math evaluation from problem solving to research-discussion modeling, covering partial progress, error detection, repair, and gradual proof synthesis. This is relevant for reasoning-data construction, process supervision, and agent-style math research evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper curates collaborative discussions from MIT PRIMES–AoPS CrowdMath (2016–2025) into 164 expert-annotated progress chains. Each chain traces an open problem to a completed proof, with posts labeled by functional roles such as partial progress, proof completion, erroneous reasoning, and error identification. These annotations define evaluation tasks for understanding research-style discussion dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 164 progress chains drawn from real multi-participant mathematical research discussions rather than synthetic traces. The abstract does not specify evaluated models, baselines, or scores, but the likely focus is on role recognition, progress-state understanding, error detection, and chain-level reasoning. The scale is modest, so statistical power may be limited, but the data format is novel.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes mathematician Pavel Etingof, and the dataset is sourced from the MIT PRIMES–AoPS CrowdMath program, giving it a strong grounding in real mathematical research discussions.

recommendation.zh: 不是大规模 benchmark，但题型分布比 GSM 式数据更接近真实研究协作；做 reasoning data 或 verifier 的人应先看标注 schema，再决定是否值得跟进。
recommendation.en: Not a large benchmark, but its distribution is much closer to real collaborative research than GSM-style math; if you work on reasoning data or verifiers, inspect the annotation schema before deciding whether to build on it.

paper.title: The Fine-Tuning Trap: Evaluating Negative Transfer and the Role of PEFT in Sub-1B Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) on edge devices requires efficient fine-tuning strategies that adapt models to new tasks without degrading their general capabilities. In this study, we benchmark five sub-1B models (135M-1B) on mathematical reasoning tasks and uncover a critical vulnerability: Full Fine-Tuning (Full FT) actively harms performance in models under 300M parameters, often dropping accuracy below zero-shot baselines. This "negative transfer" makes Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tunin

summary.core_problem: 研究 sub-1B 小模型在数学推理任务上微调时的负迁移问题，以及 PEFT 是否比全量微调更稳。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，但和 pretrain↔post-train 接口有关：它指出在小模型 regime，后训练并非总是“越强监督越好”，全量微调可能直接破坏已有能力。对小模型 recipe、mid-train 和 alignment 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较五个 135M-1B 模型在数学推理上的 Full FT、LoRA、DoRA 与 few-shot ICL 表现，重点分析参数规模与调参方式如何影响负迁移。核心结论是：在 300M 以下模型，全量微调常不稳定，而 PEFT 更像是能力保护机制。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评测了五个 sub-1B 模型，包含 Qwen2.5-0.5B、SmolLM2-135M 等；在 GSM8K、OrcaMath 等任务上，300M 以下模型做 Full FT 往往低于 zero-shot，LoRA/DoRA 更稳，其中 DoRA 在复杂推理上更强，LoRA 在模式匹配型任务上更优。没有看到更大规模或更干净的控制变量，因此结论更适合作为小模型经验法则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies negative transfer in mathematical-reasoning finetuning for sub-1B language models, and whether PEFT is more stable than full finetuning.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters at the pretrain↔post-train interface: in the small-model regime, stronger supervision is not always better, and full finetuning can actively damage existing capabilities. That is relevant to small-model recipes, mid-training, and alignment design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors benchmark five 135M-1B models on mathematical reasoning under Full FT, LoRA, DoRA, and few-shot ICL, focusing on how parameter scale interacts with adaptation strategy. The central claim is that below roughly 300M parameters, PEFT behaves more like a capability-preserving constraint than just an efficiency trick.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions five sub-1B models including Qwen2.5-0.5B and SmolLM2-135M, with tasks such as GSM8K and OrcaMath. It reports that Full FT often falls below zero-shot performance for models under 300M, while LoRA/DoRA are more stable; DoRA helps more on complex reasoning and LoRA on pattern-heavy tasks. Without stronger controls, this reads more as a useful small-model heuristic than a universal law.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但对小模型很实用：别默认 full FT 更强，<300M 先把 LoRA/DoRA 当稳定性约束看；读表格就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a new paradigm, but practical for small models: stop assuming full FT is stronger; below ~300M, treat LoRA/DoRA as stability constraints first and read the tables.

paper.title: A Comprehensive Anatomy of Human and DeepSeek-R1 LLM Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: The emergence of "Aha moments" in large language models, particularly DeepSeek-R1-0120, has raised the question of whether these systems genuinely reason or merely imitate the appearance of reasoning. We conduct a comprehensive empirical comparison between model and human reasoning across all 30 problems from AIME 2025, exhaustively annotating 10,247 reasoning steps into five functional categories: Analysis, Inference, Branch, Backtrace, and Reflection. We find a clear structural difference. Hum

summary.core_problem: 现有长思维链（CoT）数学推理模型（以DeepSeek-R1为代表）的表面推理行为与人类相似，但仅依赖最终答案正确率的评测体系无法区分模型是具备真实逻辑推理能力，还是仅模仿人类推理的拓扑结构（拓扑模仿）；此前没有细粒度的步骤级功能分类框架，来系统对比人类与模型推理轨迹的结构动力学和控制机制差异。
summary.importance: 该工作将推理能力评测从结果导向转向结构功能导向，为长CoT模型训练提供了可验证的步骤标注框架。它量化了此前未被测量的拓扑模仿现象，为推理能力的预训练与对齐监督信号设计提供了明确方向，可直接指导长推理场景下的过程奖励模型与RL目标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 研究选取AIME 2025全部30道题，收集数学竞赛参与者的人类参考解与DeepSeek-R1的所有推理轨迹，共标注10247个推理步骤，划分为5类可通过文本签名验证的功能类别：Analysis（问题规划，不产生新数学结论）、Inference（演绎推进，产生新的等式/数值/逻辑结论）、Branch（提出并行路径且不放弃当前路径）、Backtrace（撤销此前工作并返回更早状态）、Reflection（元认知重评估，以“wait”“let me check”等短语为标记）。随后系统对比人类与模型推理的步骤分布、上下文依赖与跨轨迹差异，量化了拓扑模仿的核心特征。
summary.experiments: 人类解的步骤分布中约15%为Analysis，核心是Analysis与Inference的紧凑交替，回溯极少，反思仅用于真实的分支节点；DeepSeek-R1的步骤中约40%为Analysis，反复重推导中间结论而非复用，反思频率高但90%以上为算术检查而非逻辑校验。失败的模型轨迹中，分支/回溯步骤占比要么低于5%，要么高于30%（过度滥用），而人类成功解的该占比稳定在10%-20%区间。代表性案例中，人类求解某道AIME题仅用11步、通过清晰的二分案例拆分得到正确答案，DeepSeek-R1生成132步表面结构相似的轨迹，但未完成第二个案例的推导就终止，输出错误答案。全部30道题的跨题可视化验证，长CoT的长度与反思密度和推理质量无正相关。
summary.reading_guide: 精读首先关注Section3的5类推理步骤功能定义与标注规则，这是整个研究的基础。随后阅读Section4的跨轨迹方差分析，这是区分真实推理与拓扑模仿的第一个核心指标。Section5-6的反思上下文放置与功能靶向性分析，是第二个核心指标。Section7的单题分步拆解案例，可直观理解结构差异。Section9的训练与评测启示，对预训练研究员参考价值最高。优先查看的图表包括Figure2（单题人模推理对比）、Figure8（全30题步骤分布热力图）、Table2（步骤分布统计对比表）。可深挖的方向包括：如何将步骤功能分布转化为预训练与RL的监督信号，如何在预训练阶段减少模型的拓扑模仿行为。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation paradigms for long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mathematical reasoning models (represented by DeepSeek-R1) rely solely on final answer accuracy, which cannot distinguish between genuine logical reasoning and superficial topological mimicry of human reasoning structure. No prior work has established a fine-grained, step-level functional classification framework to systematically compare structural dynamics and control mechanisms between human and model reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: This work shifts reasoning capability evaluation from result-oriented to structure-and-function-oriented, providing a verifiable step annotation framework for long-CoT model training. It quantifies the previously unmeasured phenomenon of topological mimicry, and provides explicit direction for designing pretraining and alignment supervision signals for reasoning capabilities, directly informing the design of process reward models and RL objectives for extended reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses all 30 problems from AIME 2025, collects human reference solutions from math competition participants and all reasoning traces from DeepSeek-R1, and annotates a total of 10,247 reasoning steps into 5 functionally defined categories verifiable via textual signatures: Analysis (problem setup and planning, no new mathematical conclusions), Inference (deductive progression producing new equations, values or logical claims), Branch (proposing parallel paths without abandoning the current line), Backtrace (retracting prior work to return to an earlier state), and Reflection (meta-cognitive re-evaluation marked by phrases like "wait" or "let me check"). It then systematically compares step distribution, contextual dependence and cross-trace variance between human and model reasoning, and quantifies core features of topological mimicry.
summary_en.experiments: Human solutions allocate ~15% of steps to Analysis, follow a compact alternation between Analysis and Inference, use backtracking rarely, and reserve reflection for genuine branching points. DeepSeek-R1 allocates ~40% of steps to Analysis, repeatedly re-derives intermediate conclusions instead of reusing them, and produces frequent reflections over 90% of which are shallow arithmetic checks rather than logical validation. Failed model trajectories either use branching/backtracking for less than 5% of steps or more than 30% (overuse), while successful human solutions keep the ratio between 10% and 20%. In one representative case, a human solver reached the correct answer in 11 steps with a clean two-way case split, while DeepSeek-R1 produced a 132-step trace with similar surface structure that failed to complete the second case and returned a wrong answer. Cross-problem visualization across all 30 problems confirms no positive correlation between CoT length / reflection density and reasoning quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus first on Section 3 for the 5 functional step definitions and annotation rules, the foundation of the entire study. Then read Section 4 for cross-trace variance analysis, the first core metric distinguishing genuine reasoning from mimicry. Sections 5 and 6 cover the contextual placement and functional targeting of reflection, the second core metric. Section 7 provides a step-by-step case dissection of a single problem for intuitive understanding of structural differences. Section 9 contains implications for training and evaluation, the most relevant part for pretraining researchers. Prioritize Figure 2 (single-problem human-model comparison), Figure 8 (step distribution heatmap across all 30 problems), and Table 2 (statistical comparison of step distributions). Points for further exploration include how to convert step functional distribution into supervision signals for pretraining and RL, and how to reduce topological mimicry during pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改方法，但会校正你对 R1 类长推理轨迹的直觉：先看标注体系和失败轨迹统计，别再把 token 更长误当成搜索更深。
recommendation.en: It does not give you a new method, but it should reset your intuition about R1-style long traces: read the annotation scheme and failure-trace statistics before equating more tokens with deeper search.

paper.title: LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning
paper.abstract: Implicit chain-of-thought (iCoT) methods aim to internalize reasoning in large language models, but often underperform explicit CoT prompting. We empirically find that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure. Motivated by this observation, we propose a low-rank distillation framework that transfers reasoning by aligning teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. The resulting formulation captures the glob

summary.core_problem: LoRi 解决的是隐式 CoT 蒸馏中的轨迹对齐问题：显式 CoT 的文字步骤和学生模型的 latent reasoning states 没有天然的一一对应关系，直接做局部 token-level 或中间状态监督会丢掉教师推理过程的全局结构。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train 阶段的 latent reasoning 蒸馏方法。但它有一个值得关注的观察：推理时跨 token、跨 layer 的 hidden-state trajectory 可能具有低秩结构。如果这个观察稳定成立，它对隐式推理、短 latent step 推理、以及 pretrain 阶段是否需要显式学习某类低维推理流形都有启发。贡献量级属于方法增量偏实用，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把教师模型在显式 rationale tokens 上的 hidden states 看成一个三维张量，维度大致是 rationale token 数 N、layer 数 L、hidden size H。学生模型则有 K 个隐式推理步，对应 hidden-state 张量。LoRi 不要求第 i 个显式 CoT token 对齐第 i 个 latent step，而是用 Tucker-style 低秩表示把两者投到共享低秩子空间，再匹配一阶和二阶统计量。训练目标由两部分组成：普通 CE loss 保持学生生成显式解答和答案的能力；低秩对齐 loss 负责迁移教师推理轨迹的主结构。低秩 loss 又分成 rationale-level alignment 和 anchor-level alignment。前者对齐完整推理轨迹的全局几何，后者对齐答案预测位置的表示，用来稳定从 latent reasoning 到最终答案生成的过渡。相比逐步模仿 CoT，LoRi 的主要取舍是放弃 token-level 对应，转而保留 trajectory 的主方向，因此可以把长 CoT 压缩到较短的 latent steps，并且训练上可通过预计算教师低秩表示降低开销。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA 和 Qwen 等模型族、不同模型规模，以及数学推理任务。论文报告 LoRi 相比已有 iCoT 方法有稳定提升，整体最高约提升 12%，在 GSM8K-Hard 上最高约提升 10%。更大规模模型上，LoRi 能缩小隐式 CoT 与显式 CoT 的差距。关键实验证据包括：教师推理 hidden states 的累计奇异值随 rank 增长很快，支持低秩假设；低秩轨迹对齐比局部状态监督更适合处理长 rationale 到短 latent trajectory 的蒸馏。完整表格细节需要看实验章节，尤其是不同 rank、latent step 数 K、以及 anchor loss 权重的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20–30 分钟泛读。先看 Introduction 中对 iCoT 失败原因的定位，再看 Appendix A 或对应分析图中 hidden-state trajectory 的低秩证据。方法部分重点看 Fig. 2、CE + LR 的组合目标、rationale-level alignment 和 anchor-level alignment 的定义。实验部分优先看 GSM8K-Hard、多步数学题、不同模型规模的结果，以及 rank/K/anchor loss 的消融。值得深挖的是低秩结构是否只是数学推理任务上的现象，还是更普遍的推理表征规律。

summary_en.core_problem: LoRi targets a specific weakness in implicit CoT distillation: explicit rationale tokens do not have a well-defined step-by-step correspondence to a student model’s latent reasoning states. Local token-level or sampled-state supervision can miss the global structure of the teacher’s reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Its relevance is mainly to post-training and latent reasoning. The useful signal is the empirical claim that hidden-state trajectories during reasoning, stacked across tokens and layers, are well approximated by a low-rank structure. If this holds beyond the tested math settings, it suggests a concrete way to think about compact latent reasoning and about whether pretraining should encourage models to form low-dimensional reasoning manifolds. The contribution is practical and incremental rather than foundational, so it is best treated as a skim paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method represents the teacher’s explicit reasoning process as a hidden-state tensor over rationale tokens, layers, and hidden dimensions. The student produces a shorter tensor over a small number of implicit reasoning steps, layers, and hidden dimensions. Instead of aligning individual CoT tokens to latent steps, LoRi projects both tensors into a shared low-rank Tucker-style subspace and aligns their first- and second-order statistics. The training objective combines standard cross-entropy, which preserves the student’s ability to generate explicit solutions and final answers, with a low-rank alignment loss. The alignment loss has two parts: rationale-level alignment captures the global geometry of the teacher’s reasoning trajectory, while anchor-level alignment regularizes the representation at the answer prediction position. The main design choice is to avoid brittle local correspondence and transfer only the dominant trajectory structure, making it possible to distill long rationales into a small number of latent steps.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover LLaMA and Qwen model families at multiple scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. LoRi consistently improves over prior implicit CoT methods, with reported gains up to about 12% overall and about 10% on GSM8K-Hard. At larger model scales, it narrows the gap between implicit CoT and explicit CoT prompting. The key empirical support is the rapid growth of normalized cumulative singular values for hidden-state trajectories, which motivates the low-rank assumption. The most informative ablations are expected around the low-rank dimension, the number of latent reasoning steps, and the contribution of the anchor alignment term.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode of existing implicit CoT distillation. Then inspect the low-rank trajectory evidence, especially the singular-value analysis. In the method section, focus on the objective decomposition, the rationale-level and anchor-level losses, and the tensor low-rank projection in Fig. 2. In the experiments, prioritize GSM8K-Hard, multi-step math results, scaling trends, and ablations over rank and latent-step count. The main question to keep in mind is whether the low-rank trajectory phenomenon is task-specific or a more general property of reasoning representations.

recommendation.zh: 低秩 hidden-state trajectory 这个假设值得认真看，可能影响你对 latent reasoning 蒸馏目标的设计；先看方法节和主表，别急着相信“接近 explicit CoT”的口号。
recommendation.en: The low-rank hidden-state trajectory hypothesis is the part worth your attention; read the method and main tables first, and be cautious about the 'near explicit CoT' claim.

paper.title: Critic-Guided Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reasoning for Reliable Mathematical Problem Solving
paper.abstract: Recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive reasoning abilities; but they are still susceptible to hallucinations, intermediate reasoning mistakes, and unreliable reasoning results in complex mathematical reasoning problems. In this study, we introduce a critic-based heterogeneous multi-agent approach to improve the dependability of mathematical reasoning. This framework incorporates several LLM agents of different specialties and employs a critic-driven adaptive learning system to

summary.core_problem: LLM在复杂数学推理中易产生幻觉、中间推理错误和不可靠结果；需要能自适应纠错并防止错误级联的推理框架。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将批评家引导机制与异构多Agent系统结合，验证者不仅判断正确性还提供批评以指导解的再生，实现自适应错误纠正。
summary.technical_approach: 批评家引导的异构多Agent推理框架：多个不同专长的LLM Agent；基于批评家的自适应学习系统评估和引导推理过程；生成器-验证器架构，验证器提供具体批评指导解的再生。
summary.experiments: 在GSM8K基准上比单轮和非批评家模型提升高达13%准确率；仅两作者独立工作，未使用知名机构资源。
summary.authors_note: Muhammad Talha Sharif, Abdul Rehman；两作者独立工作，机构未明确。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs are susceptible to hallucinations, intermediate reasoning errors, and unreliable results in complex mathematical reasoning; need frameworks that adaptively correct errors and prevent error cascading.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: combines critic-guided mechanism with heterogeneous multi-agent system; validator not only judges correctness but also provides critiques to guide solution regeneration, enabling adaptive error correction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Critic-guided heterogeneous multi-agent reasoning framework: multiple LLM agents of different specialties; critic-driven adaptive learning system assesses and guides reasoning; generator-validator architecture with validator providing critiques.
summary_en.experiments: Up to 13% accuracy improvement over single-shot and non-critic models on GSM8K; two-author independent work, no major institutional resources.
summary_en.authors_note: Muhammad Talha Sharif, Abdul Rehman; two-author independent work, institution unclear.

recommendation.zh: 典型的多Agent数学推理套壳工作，GSM8K上13%提升但基线不清楚，机构非知名，作为弱信号备查。
recommendation.en: Typical multi-agent math reasoning wrapper work; 13% GSM8K improvement but baselines unclear; non-major institution; file as weak signal.

paper.title: FormInv: A Measurement Protocol for Semantic Invariance in Mathematical Reasoning Benchmarks
paper.abstract: A paraphrase-quality audit of MathCheck (ICLR 2025) detected 4 semantically incorrect paraphrases in 129 groups (3.1%); removing them drops GPT-4o from rank 2 to rank 4 and elevates Claude Haiku and DeepSeek V3 above it; these ranking changes are invisible to any single-model evaluation. Cross-model unanimity found these errors automatically (>= 3/4 models for MathCheck; >= 6/9 for our primary evaluation) for under $10; in our own dataset the same protocol found that 47% of auto-generated connec

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是数学推理评测中的“同义改写不变性”没有被系统测量。模型在标准 accuracy 上表现不错，并不意味着它能在逻辑等价的表述下给出一致答案。
summary.importance: 这项工作属于评测方法，但对预训练和后训练都有直接启发。数学数据合成、SFT/RL 训练和 benchmark 排名都依赖题目表述的可靠性。如果等价改写会导致模型答案大幅波动，accuracy 会高估模型的概念理解，也会掩盖训练数据中由改写生成带来的标签噪声。FormInv 的价值在于把数学 reasoning 的评测从单题 accuracy 扩展到等价类内一致性，并给出可自动发现错误 paraphrase 的审计协议。
summary.technical_approach: FormInv 把一个数学命题的多种等价表述视为同一个 equivalence class。模型在这个类内的回答如果不恒定，就存在 Invariance Gap。作者用 L2 条件期望给出形式化定义：类内均值是对模型二值回答的最优常数近似，偏离表示模型对表述形式敏感。实际指标包括 IG、SCR 和每定理 Cochran’s Q。SCR 是更严格的语义一致正确率，只统计模型在所有等价表述上都回答正确的定理。数据构造上，FormInv 使用 Lean4/Mathlib4 验证的定理，并把改写分成 T1、T2、T3 三类：T1 可形式验证，T2 在模板或条件下有效，T3 依赖启发式与专家审核。另一个重要部分是 cross-model unanimity audit：如果多个模型在 canonical 题上通过、但在某个 paraphrase 上一致失败，就把该改写标为可疑。这比单模型检查更容易发现语义改写错误。
summary.experiments: 主要评测包含 760 个 items，覆盖 103 个 Lean4-verified Mathlib4 定理、8 类改写、9 个前沿模型；另有 811 个 items 来自 100 个更难的 ntp-mathlib 定理。结果显示 accuracy 和一致性可以明显分离：Claude Haiku 4.5 accuracy 为 86%，但 SCR 只有 50%；DeepSeek V3 accuracy 为 96.4%，SCR 为 82%。10 个点的 accuracy 差距对应 32 个点的 SCR 差距。不同改写族还会导致模型排序反转，例如 comparison-order 改写上 Claude Sonnet 有 16.7% 的失败，而 GPT-4o 为 0.0%；definition expansion 改写上 GPT-4o 失败 10.0%，Claude 约 6–8%。质量审计也很有用：对 MathCheck 的 paraphrase audit 在 129 组中发现 4 个语义错误，比例 3.1%；移除这些错误后，GPT-4o 从第 2 名降到第 4 名，Claude Haiku 和 DeepSeek V3 超过它。作者自己的自动 connective-variation 改写中，47% 被发现语义错误。cross-model unanimity 的成本很低，文中估计每个模型每轮约 1 美元，MathCheck 设置下总成本低于 10 美元。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Invariance Gap 和 SCR 的定义，重点理解为什么 SCR 比 accuracy 更接近“等价表述下的可靠数学能力”。然后看 Table 1 和 Table 2：前者说明现有 benchmark 对 paraphrase 等价性的验证不足，后者说明不同改写类型的可信度分层。实验部分优先看 9 模型 accuracy/SCR 对比、按 paraphrase family 分解的失败率，以及 MathCheck audit 的排名变化。若关心训练数据质量，可以重点看 cross-model unanimity 作为自动 paraphrase 审计信号的部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The core problem is that mathematical reasoning benchmarks usually measure accuracy on one formulation of a problem, while leaving semantic invariance under equivalent reformulations largely unmeasured.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant as an evaluation and data-quality protocol. Math pretraining data, SFT data, RL prompts, and benchmark leaderboards often rely on paraphrased problems. If logically equivalent formulations change model answers, raw accuracy can overstate conceptual robustness. It can also hide label noise introduced by automatic paraphrase generation. FormInv adds a second axis of measurement: consistency within equivalence classes, not just correctness on isolated items.
summary_en.technical_approach: FormInv treats all logically equivalent formulations of a theorem as an equivalence class. A model’s binary answer function should be constant within that class. The Invariance Gap formalizes deviation from constancy using an L2 conditional-expectation view: the class-conditional mean is the best constant approximation to the model’s answers, and residual variation measures sensitivity to formulation. SCR, the Semantic Consistency Rate, is stricter: it counts only the theorems where the model answers correctly across all paraphrases. The benchmark uses Lean4-verified mathematical statements and organizes paraphrase families into three reliability tiers: formally certifiable, conditionally valid, and heuristic. A separate cross-model unanimity audit flags likely paraphrase errors when many models pass the canonical item but fail the same paraphrase.
summary_en.experiments: The main benchmark contains 760 items from 103 Lean4-verified Mathlib4 theorems across 8 paraphrase families and 9 models. A harder extension contains 811 items from 100 ntp-mathlib theorems. The results show a large gap between accuracy and invariance. Claude Haiku 4.5 reaches 86% accuracy but only 50% SCR. DeepSeek V3 reaches 96.4% accuracy and 82% SCR, so a 10-point accuracy difference corresponds to a 32-point SCR difference. Model rankings also depend on paraphrase family. For comparison-order changes, Claude Sonnet fails 16.7% while GPT-4o fails 0.0%. For definition expansion, GPT-4o fails 10.0% while Claude fails roughly 6–8%. The audit results are also important. In MathCheck, 4 semantically incorrect paraphrases are found among 129 groups, about 3.1%; removing them moves GPT-4o from rank 2 to rank 4. In the authors’ own connective-variation generation, 47% of audited paraphrases are semantically incorrect. The proposed unanimity audit is cheap, estimated at about one dollar per model per run and under ten dollars in the MathCheck setting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Read the definitions of Invariance Gap and SCR first, since they are the main measurement contribution. Then inspect the paraphrase-family taxonomy and the benchmark construction details, especially which transformations are formally verified and which rely on templates or expert review. In the results, prioritize the accuracy-versus-SCR table, per-family failure breakdowns, and the MathCheck audit showing ranking changes after removing invalid paraphrases. For pretraining or post-training data work, the most reusable component is the cross-model unanimity signal for paraphrase-quality auditing.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改变你看数学 benchmark 的方式：以后别只盯 accuracy，先查 paraphrase 质量和 SCR；先读摘要、指标定义和排名翻转那张表。
recommendation.en: This should change how you read math benchmarks: stop trusting accuracy alone, and inspect paraphrase validity plus SCR first; read the metric definition and the rank-flip table.

paper.title: DenseSteer: Steering Small Language Models towards Dense Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning abilities, while smaller models (<= 3B parameters) significantly underperform on multi-step reasoning tasks. Based on empirical analyses of the Qwen-2.5 model family on math reasoning benchmarks, we find that more proficient reasoning is associated with fewer reasoning steps but higher information density per step, a property we term Dense Reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we propose DenseSteer, a training-f

summary.core_problem: DenseSteer 解决的是小模型在数学 CoT 推理中步骤多、信息密度低、又难以直接吸收大模型推理轨迹的问题，目标是在不训练模型的情况下改善推理结构和答案准确率。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 post-train 与推理机制分析有启发。它把小模型推理能力不足的一部分归因到“推理轨迹结构”而不只是知识不足或参数量不足，并用 token-level NLL 检查外部教师轨迹是否落在学生模型可生成分布内。这个视角对蒸馏数据构造有用：高质量教师答案不一定是好训练信号，学生模型能否自然建模这些轨迹同样重要。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先在 Qwen2.5 系列上观察数学推理差异：更强模型往往使用更少的中间步骤，但每一步包含更多有效信息，作者称为 Dense Reasoning。随后提出 DenseSteer，一个 training-free 的 inference-time steering 方法。关键不是直接把小模型 hidden states 拉向大模型轨迹，因为跨模型或跨家族轨迹在学生模型下的 NLL 更高，容易造成分布错位。作者改用 Dense-Rewriting：先让小模型生成自己的解题过程，再用 GPT-5.1 将其改写成更紧凑、更高信息密度的形式，作为正样本；原始或低密度版本作为对照，构造 steering vector。推理时在指定层的内部表示上加这个方向，使生成更接近 dense reasoning，而不需要额外 SFT 或大规模蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕小模型数学推理展开，主要使用 Qwen2.5 家族中不超过 3B 参数的模型，并分析 GSM8K 等数学数据。分布兼容性部分在 200 个 GSM8K 样本上计算学生模型对不同来源推理轨迹的 token-level NLL，结果显示跨家族参考轨迹 NLL 更高，同模型自身输出最低，因此直接用强教师轨迹做 steering 会引入更明显的分布偏移。主实验显示 DenseSteer 在多个数学推理任务上带来稳定准确率提升，同时没有增加 token-level NLL。消融的关键点是 Dense-Rewriting 优于直接使用大模型推理轨迹，说明“保留学生分布、只改推理结构”比“模仿强教师表面风格”更稳。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20 分钟左右即可。建议重点看 Section 3.1 的 NLL 分布差异实验，这部分解释了为什么不能直接用大模型 trace 做 steering；再看 Dense Reasoning metric 的定义，确认作者如何量化“步骤更少但信息更密”。方法部分关注 Dense-Rewriting 如何构造 contrastive pairs，以及 steering vector 加在哪些层、强度如何调。实验部分重点看准确率和 NLL 是否同时报告，以及不同正样本来源的消融。若关注蒸馏或小模型推理训练，这篇的价值主要在数据可学习性和分布兼容性，而不是 steering 技术本身。

summary_en.core_problem: DenseSteer targets a specific failure mode of small language models in mathematical CoT reasoning: they often produce fragmented, low-density reasoning traces, while direct imitation of large-model traces can be distributionally incompatible.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is useful for post-training, distillation, and reasoning analysis. Its main signal is that reasoning quality should not be judged only by final correctness or trace length. The likelihood of teacher traces under the student model matters. A strong teacher rationale can be a poor training or steering target if it lies far outside the student’s generation distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze the Qwen2.5 model family and identify a pattern they call Dense Reasoning: stronger models tend to use fewer intermediate steps while packing more useful information into each step. DenseSteer then uses inference-time activation steering rather than fine-tuning. A naive version would build steering vectors from large-model traces, but the paper shows that such traces often have higher token-level NLL under the small target model, especially across model families. To avoid this mismatch, Dense-Rewriting is introduced. The small model first generates its own solution; GPT-5.1 then rewrites that solution into a denser style while staying closer to the student’s distribution. These rewritten traces serve as positive anchors for contrastive steering-vector construction. At inference time, the vector is added to selected hidden representations to bias the model toward denser reasoning without SFT or large-scale distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on math reasoning with small models, mainly Qwen2.5 variants at or below 3B parameters, and include GSM8K-style analysis. For distribution compatibility, the paper computes token-level NLL on 200 GSM8K examples under the student model. Cross-family reference traces receive higher NLL, while the student’s own outputs are the most compatible, supporting the decision to rewrite student outputs rather than directly import teacher traces. The main results show consistent accuracy gains on math reasoning tasks without increasing token-level NLL. The important ablation is the comparison between Dense-Rewriting-based steering and steering from raw large-model rationales; the former is more stable because it changes the reasoning structure while preserving much of the student’s native distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is sufficient. Focus first on Section 3.1, where NLL is used to diagnose distribution mismatch between student models and candidate reference traces. Then read the definition of the Dense Reasoning metric to see how the paper operationalizes fewer but denser steps. In the method section, check how contrastive pairs are built, which layers are steered, and how steering strength is selected. In the experiments, pay attention to whether accuracy and NLL are reported together, and to ablations over positive-sample sources. For readers working on distillation or small-model reasoning, the main takeaway is the learnability and distribution-compatibility criterion, more than the activation-steering mechanism itself.

recommendation.zh: 核心发现（更强推理=更少步骤+更高信息密度）对思考CoT训练数据的结构设计有启发，建议看实证分析部分；推理时调控方法本身对预训练直接价值有限。
recommendation.en: The core finding (stronger reasoning = fewer steps + higher information density) is insightful for designing CoT training data structures; read the empirical analysis section. The inference-time steering method itself has limited direct pretrain value.

paper.title: Prefix-Safe Bayesian Belief Tracking for LLM Reasoning Reliability:Separating Calibration from Ranking
paper.abstract: Long reasoning traces need reliability estimates before final answers are known. We study prefix-conditioned eventual-success estimation, $P(y=1 \mid o_{1:t})$, using prefix-safe observations. Sequential Bayesian Belief Tracking (SBBT) calibrates observation likelihoods and recursively updates a two-state belief, providing a common tracker for scalar scores, text and self-verification markers, hidden clusters, token-pooling probes, and latent-trajectory features. Across generated open-weight tra

summary.core_problem: 长推理链生成时，需要在“答案尚未生成/尚未知对错”的前提下，对当前前缀是否仍可能最终成功给出在线概率估计，即估计 P(y=1 | o_{1:t})，并且观测必须满足 prefix-safe（不能偷看未来 token 或最终答案）。论文要解决的是：在统一的在线更新框架下，如何把不同类型的前缀证据（标量分数、文本标记、自验证、hidden cluster、probe、轨迹特征）做校准并递推融合，同时区分“概率质量（calibration/Brier）”与“排序能力（AUROC）”这两类经常被混在一起的目标。
summary.importance:
对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏 post-train/推理时可靠性与监控。但它对预训练研究的启发在于两点：
1) 把“长链推理的可靠性”拆成可操作的在线估计任务，并强调 prefix-safe 边界，这对训练时做过程监督、以及推理时 early stopping/compute-aware decoding 有直接接口。
2) 明确指出 calibration 与 ranking 可分离：仅靠标量置信度类信号可能改善 Brier 但不提升 AUROC；要提升排序往往需要结构化证据。这会反过来影响你在预训练/中训阶段是否要显式塑造可监控的中间表征与自验证行为。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Sequential Bayesian Belief Tracking (SBBT)：一个两状态（高可靠 H / 低可靠 L）的贝叶斯滤波器，把“证据抽取—似然校准—在线递推”拆开。
- 任务定义：对每条 trace，按前缀 t 提取观测 o_t，只允许使用前缀内信息与当下可得元数据；监督信号是最终答案正确性 y∈{0,1}。
- 观测接口（可插拔）：
  1) 连续标量分数（如 token entropy、verifier 分数、模型自评等）；
  2) 离散 concept/code（如文本模式、自验证标记、hidden cluster assignment）；
  3) token-pooling probes 与 latent-trajectory 特征。
- 校准：先在 question-level 切分的 train/calibration 上拟合状态条件似然 P(o_t|z_t)。默认做“all-prefix calibration”，把最终 y 弱传播到各前缀作为监督；同时还评估 final-step 与 EM 变体，避免弱监督假设过强。
- 递推：用两状态转移 + 观测似然做标准 Bayesian filtering，输出每个前缀的 belief 轨迹，最终用于在线可靠性分数。
- 论文强调的分析框架：在相同滤波器下替换证据源，观察哪些证据提升 Brier（概率质量），哪些提升 AUROC（排序），从而做 evidence decomposition。
summary.experiments:
覆盖多个开源权重模型生成的推理 traces：MATH-500、GSM8K、AIME 2025、RIMO-N。
- 主要结论是“概率质量与排序分离”：score-only 的 SBBT 往往能改善 Brier，但 AUROC 的提升需要更结构化的 prefix-safe 证据（hidden cluster、文本/自验证标记、轨迹特征等），且在更难的数学设置下，强基线（如长度感知的 AIME baselines、learned-prefix/长度特征）可能压过一些结构信号。
- 评测协议：按 trace 级别用最终在线分数评估，也会在固定前缀比例（5%/50%/100%）评估 belief；数据划分是 question-level，避免同题 traces 泄漏。

summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction：把 prefix-safe 约束、在线目标 P(y=1|o_{1:t})、以及“calibration vs ranking 分离”的经验现象建立起来。
- 再读 Method：重点看观测接口的边界（Table 1）与校准流程（all-prefix vs final-step vs EM），理解它为什么把“证据质量”与“时间递推”解耦。
- 实验部分优先看：不同证据家族在不同数据集/模型族上的对比，以及在固定前缀比例下的曲线；这些最能回答“什么证据在什么时候有用”。
- 如果你关心与训练的连接：留意作者对“弱监督把最终 y 传播到前缀”的讨论，它决定了该方法更像在线监控而不是过程错误定位。

summary_en.core_problem: During long-form reasoning, we often need an online estimate of eventual success before the final answer is produced, under a strict prefix-safe constraint. The paper formulates this as estimating P(y=1 | o_{1:t}) from prefix-only observations, and aims to provide a unified belief-tracking framework that can ingest heterogeneous evidence while explicitly separating probability calibration quality from ranking performance.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper; it sits closer to inference-time reliability and post-training monitoring. The pretraining-relevant takeaway is the clean decomposition it enforces: scalar confidence signals can improve calibration (e.g., Brier) without improving discriminative ranking (AUROC), and ranking gains often require structured, prefix-safe evidence. That observation feeds back into how one might shape intermediate behaviors (self-verification, trace structure) during mid-training or alignment so that monitoring signals become more informative.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Sequential Bayesian Belief Tracking (SBBT) is a two-state Bayesian filter over a latent reliability state (High/Low).
- Task: given a reasoning trace segmented into prefixes, extract prefix-safe observations o_t and predict eventual correctness y.
- Evidence interface: plug-in observation families including continuous scores (entropy/verifier/confidence), discrete codes (text markers, self-verification flags, hidden-cluster IDs), token-pooling probes, and latent-trajectory features.
- Calibration-first design: fit state-conditional likelihoods P(o_t | z_t) on held-out calibration splits (question-level). Default supervision propagates final labels to prefixes (weak supervision), with alternatives such as final-step calibration and EM variants.
- Online filtering: combine calibrated likelihoods with a simple transition model to produce a belief trajectory over time. The key methodological point is holding the temporal integration constant while swapping evidence sources to attribute gains to evidence rather than to the tracker.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on open-weight generated traces across MATH-500, GSM8K, AIME 2025, and RIMO-N.
- Main empirical claim: calibration and ranking separate. Score-only SBBT often improves probability quality (Brier), while AUROC improvements typically require structure-aware evidence (text/self-verification markers, hidden clusters, trajectory features), and some hard-math settings are dominated by strong prefix-safe baselines (e.g., length-aware features).
- Protocol details highlighted in the excerpt: trace-level evaluation using the final online score; also evaluation at fixed prefix fractions (5%/50%/100%); question-level splits to prevent leakage.
The provided content snippet does not include the full numeric tables/plots, so exact AUROC/Brier values cannot be quoted here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the prefix-safe boundary and the explicit calibration-vs-ranking separation.
- In the Method section, focus on the observation boundary (what is allowed at prefix time), and the calibration variants (all-prefix vs final-step vs EM).
- In Experiments, prioritize the evidence-family ablations across datasets/models and the prefix-fraction analyses; those sections answer when each signal is non-redundant.
- If you care about training implications, pay attention to the discussion around weakly propagating final labels to prefixes—this is monitoring-oriented, not process-error localization.

recommendation.zh: 看 calibration-vs-ranking 的结果即可；对做 verifier 或 RLVR 过滤的人，比方法包装更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the calibration-versus-ranking results; for verifier or RLVR filtering work, that lesson matters more than the method wrapper.

paper.title: IRDS: Interpretable RLVR Data Selection via Verifier-Coupled Sparse Autoencoder Coverage
